notes.title: Hotfix Update v2.2.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

We hope everyone is enjoying the changes to the Architect fight and the addition of the True Architect! As usual, we've been listening to all the feedback and have put together a small patch to make a few balancing changes and to fix a few bugs. Please see below for all the details that are included with Update 2.2.1!


[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Ronin Reflex[/h3]
[list][*]Updated to remove the window where the player was vulnerable if they did not successfully counter an attack[*]Updated to always allow the player to cancel the counter stance with a roll[*]Updated to allow the player to move, at a reduced speed, while in the counter stance[*]Increased the counter timer from 1.0s to 1.4s[*]Increased the counter radius from 70 to 75[*]Increased the projectile destruction time from 0.8s to 1.2s[/list]
[h3]True Architect[/h3]
[list][*]Updated to no longer support stealing skills[*]Updated the attack patterns in all four phases[list][*][i][b]DEV NOTE:[/b] The goal of this change is to make the inverted controls and item stealing easier to deal with by making the Architect always use the Teleport Barrage attack right after the phase transition. This should act as a consistent grace period before the Architect resumes his normal attack patterns.[/i]
[/list][*]Reduced the attack speed in phase 4[*]Updated the teleport barrage attack to allow the True Architect to be damaged while firing the horizontal blasts[*]Reduced the damage dealt by the teleport barrage attack[*]Updated the elemental barrage attack to prevent the same element from being chosen multiple times in a row[*]Updated the stolen item orbs to support getting hit immediately after being fired[*]Updated the stolen item orbs to be targeted by Aim Assist[*]Updated the stolen item orbs to prioritize orbs with items when deciding which orbs invert your controls[*]Reduced the True Architect’s max health and damage in Boss Rush[*]Reduced the Fallen Knight’s damage in Boss Rush[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback or assistance[/i]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the Void Mantle’s Dark Star was not properly activating stun relics[*]Fixed a bug where the proper skills would sometimes not be given at the start of a Daily Dungeon 🔥[*]Fixed a bug where Totality would be stuck enabled if the modifier was enabled in a previous game version 🔥[*]Fixed a bug where the player would have significantly reduced invulnerability while rolling if the player was charging an attack before rolling 🔥[*]Fixed a bug with saving and quitting where the reload process may not function properly after repeatedly saving and quitting[*][WotA] Fixed an issue where the True Architect’s hitbox was reduced significantly 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed an issue where the Reborn Knight’s hitboxes were reduced significantly 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed an issue with the True Architect’s constellation attack where the hitbox of the beam was wider than the visual 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the player would get stuck when using the Hyper Gloves dash charge attack against bosses 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed a few issues where some cursed relics would reapply their cursed effect after being stolen by the True Architect 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the Mimic King’s Consort would get stuck in the True Architect’s arena 🔥[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where Lady Inferna would sometimes be permanently invincible after her phase transition[*][WotA] Fixed a few issues where some skills were unable to damage the item orbs in the True Architect fight[*][WotA] Fixed a visual issue where a rock was not fading out during the Architect's intro animation 🔥[/list]


That's everything for now. As always, thanks for all the support!

-Doom Turtle


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]


[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

As always, if you want to stay on top of the news, be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

And of course, join our [url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]Discord[/url] and share your thoughts on the update!

notes.title: Architect Unleashed Update!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

We've been a little quiet about this update, so we hope this comes as an exciting surprise!


[h1]Testers Appreciation![/h1]
First and foremost, we'd like to extend a big appreciation and thank you to those who played and provided feedback on the changes to the Architect boss fight! You were a big help and we're really happy with where we ended up. We hope you are too!

[previewyoutube=3hbPuRmDk_A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Steward Plushies[/h1]
We have some exciting news about our Steward plushies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c2de5ab5431f9b618a2e335e2416b969f8a06c30.gif[/img]
[b]The store is now open![/b]
https://www.makeship.com/products/steward-ember-knights-1


If you missed reserving your very own plushie, now is your chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f2213dadc950fbd9edce82c7c7f9011343b10083.png[/img]
We received a test plushie before approving production, and the quality was even better than we expected. These little guys turned out amazing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f90bb5b356216284634f631b3cf43651f19720dd.gif[/img]


[h1]Consoles Update[/h1]
We're still progressing nicely with the Xbox and PS5 ports. We don't have a more specific timeline yet, but we're still targeting summer. We know you're excited to get your hands on Ember Knights, and we are too! 


And now onto the details for [b]Update 2.2 - Architect Unleashed![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
[i]Note: Updates to the DLC content requires the Wrath of the Architect DLC. Items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.[/i]

[h2]New Content & Major Adjustments[/h2] 

[h3]True Architect Fight & New Skill & New Player Color[/h3]
[list][*]Activate enough difficulty modifiers to experience the brand new True Architect fight! That's right...nobody knew this was coming![/list][h3]Regular Architect Fight[/h3]
[list][*]Updated to increase the challenge of the fight to better align with the difficulty of the Praxis fight![/list][h3]Boss Rush Tier 10[/h3]
[list][*]With the True Architect fight, we've added a 10th tier to the Boss Rush![/list][h3]Multiplayer Lobbies[/h3]
[list][*]Updated Steam lobbies to show all multiplayer games![/list]

[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2] 

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list][*]Ember Blade[list][*]Updated Lunge to allow players to dash over pits 🔥[*]Increased the stun chance from 10% to 25% for Stagger[*]Added a 10% crit chance to weapon attacks against burning enemies for Pyrostrike[/list][*]Guardian Bow[list][*]Increased the bonus damage from 10% to 25% for Opportunist
[/list][*]Rift Hammer[list][*]Increased the max health damage from 10% to 20% for Heavy Blow[/list][*]Razor Wind[list][*]Increased the crit chance from 10% to 15% for Sharpened Tipper[*]Added a 25% bonus crit chance to perfect charge attacks for Sharpened Tipper[/list][*]Reaper's Toll[list][*]Increased the bonus damage from 10% to 15% for Lacerate[/list][*]Void Mantle 🔥[list][*]Updated the chain attack to grant an Orb when hitting an enemy[*]Updated the chain attack to have increased attack speed[*]Updated Dark Star to now stun enemies when pulling them[*]Updated Dark Clone to have a cooldown timer in the HUD[*]Passive Orb Generation - increased from one orb every 1s to 1.5s[*]Chain Attack Move Speed - increased from 15% to 25%[*]Charge Attack Charge Time - reduced from 2s to 1.25s[*]Charge Attack Radius - increased from 110 to 125[*]Charge Attack Damage Per Orb - increased from 0.33x to 0.4x[*]Charge Attack Move Speed - increased from 15% to 40%[*]Laser Focus Damage Per Orb - increased from 0.25x to 0.6x[*]Laser Focus Range - increased from 200 to 250[*]Dark Spell: Dark Star Suction Radius - increased from 85 to 90[*]Dark Spell: Dark Star Explosion Radius - increased from 50 to 75[*]Dark Spell: Dark Star Explosion Damage - increased from 50 to 60[*]Dark Spell: Dark Star Max Health Damage - increased from 10%  to 25%[list][i][*]Dev Note: If the damage from Dark Star is less than 25% of the enemy’s Max HP, it deals that value as damage instead[/i][/list][*]Dark Spell: Darkening Damage - increased from 30 to 35 per bolt[*]Dark Spell: Darkening Max HP Damage - increased from 10% to 15%[list][i][*]Dev Note: If the damage from Darkening is less than 15% of the enemy’s Max HP, it deals that value as damage instead[/i][/list][/list][*]Hyper Gloves[list][*]Updated the charge attack to allow players to dash over pits 🔥[/list][/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*]Updated the camera panning when spawning rewards in Netherra to make the movement smoother
[*]Updated the portals in Netherra to ensure drops don't spawn on or near them 🔥
[*]Added enemy stats to the Endless Mode confirmation screen 🔥
[*]Added the ability for the player to open their inventory while on the Endless Mode confirmation screen 🔥
[*]Updated the description for Bane of Wisdom to better indicate which skill slot is being locked
[*]Various other localization improvements 🔥[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 

Last but not least, we squashed a big bunch of bugs.
[list][*]Fixed a bug in the weapon modding screen where the wrong input was bound when using a controller 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing players without the DLC to access the DLC difficulty modifiers 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with aim assist that was causing it to target invincible traps in the boss room of Anville 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues in Boss Rush with the Anville and Simulan minibosses 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Warrior Wisps, Ballista, Summon Geo, Hydra, Yalee Barrage, and Buster Ammo that could still activate the generic healing skill upgrade if the upgrade is equipped to the other skill
[*]Fixed a bug with Hailstone Armor where the snowballs could be released during room transitions and boss intros 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing players to offer duplicate relics at the Offering Pit
[*]Fixed a bug where Praxis encounters could appear in both Netherras
[*]Fixed a bug where beating Boss Rush 3 or 4 displays True Praxis as the only defeated boss 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the ultimate weapon mod from being automatically equipped when unlocked 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the Ember Tree tooltip from updating after changing the equipped upgrades
[*]Fixed a bug with the seeking ghosts where they could get stuck if their target dies as they begin seeking
[*]Fixed a visual bug where some Tyrant effects can activate when entering a shop or leaving a secret room 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing different boss variants from appearing while looping
[*]Fixed a bug with Trinity that was preventing ash or ember from being awarded from each boss
[*]Fixed a bug where the Wights would continue to spawn from Bane of Wights during phase transitions
[*]Fixed a bug with Explosive Arrows where they couldn’t damage or break traps 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with text in multiplayer games
[*]Fixed a bug with Boss Rush and Daily Dungeon where the shop refund popup was automatically  being dismissed if the player is using a controller 🔥
[*]Fixed some performance issues related to constantly opening and closing the Ember Tree UI 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the Suppression Obelisks where the number of hits to destroy them was affected by the Chaos modifier 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Doom Shell where the visual could persist after the relic is removed 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Champion Gar-Ghoul where its drops could be unreachable 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the player’s visual could become shifted upwards if they died while lifted by Praxis
[*]Fixed a bug with Forlorn where its laser indicator was incorrectly turning on spawn
[*]Fixed a bug where stat gem icons in the inventory would incorrectly scale in some localizations
[*]Fixed a bug where the cursor would be in the incorrect location when opening the Daily Dungeon screen
[*]Fixed a bug where Ember Tree upgrade prices could display as red when the player has enough Ember to purchase them 🔥
[*]Fixed some issues where boss trophies were being incorrectly awarded when the Trinity difficulty modifier is enabled
[*]Fixed a bug where Esper's dialog would be incorrect at the beginning of the game
[*]Fixed some issues with Hailstone Armor where the snowballs could expire while waiting to be thrown
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing some sounds from playing when Esper identifies a relic orb
[*]Fixed a bug where Daily Dungeon bosses were spawning drops that could not be collected
[*]Fixed some issues where the Voltage Traps were not behaving properly during the Cleanup Crew miniboss fight
[*]Fixed a bug where some Ember Tree visuals were playing incorrectly
[*]Fixed a bug where Evee was not animating properly when identifying a skill
[*]Fixed some visual issues that could occur when quickly navigating the weapon mod screen
[*]Fixed some visual issues with the Glacial Bruma boss
[*]Fixed a bug where skill details in the inventory would not update after swapping skills
[*]Fixed a bug where some text in the Ember Shrine screen could become yellow
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug that was causing the equipped weapon and player colors to be reset for additional players after playing Daily Dungeon 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug that was preventing the first weapon mod in a row to be automatically equipped when unlocked 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where clients could become desynced with the host if the host interacts with the armor stand in the Refinement Shop
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug that was allowing disconnected players to cause a skill tablet to drop even if all players already have that skill 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where playing solo could cause issues with the HUD transparency in local multiplayer games 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where the missed state of Scout and Ranger wasn’t properly networked
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug in local multiplayer where Player 3’s Knight could walk offscreen during a Praxis encounter in Anville
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where players can confirm other players’ selections in selectors
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a few issues with boss attacks where the attack path would be different for clients
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug with Royal Phalanx where his leap attack could get stuck in the air in some cases for clients
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug with gaining stats from perfect room relics where a desync could occur if any clients are disconnected 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug that was causing respawn issues for a client if they disconnected while the Mimic King’s Consort pet is alive 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where button prompts on skill slots in selectors were not shown in some cases
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where clients would not see Yalee Barrage unlocked properly 🔥
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed some issues where some relics were being generated incorrectly
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where some players would not appear during the Netherra intro cutscene
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where players would play the incorrect animation when being revived by a Healing Spring
[*][Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where Arch Praxis’ health bar would not be displayed properly in some cases
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the secret door in Inferno Bastille could not be opened during combat
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the secret door in Akamura could not be opened with Summon Geo during combat
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the Nexus music would stop playing until the DLC intro cutscene is seen
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with Explosive Jab where the bomb wouldn’t deal damage if a new bomb replaced it
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where Sticky Bomb’s damage was only boosted by Giant Mace when an enemy dies
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with the secret door projectile in Simulan where it could be destroyed by Ronin Reflex 🔥
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with the meteors from Molten Boulder’s ultimate upgrade where they wouldn’t freeze with Brittle Scepter
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with Daily Dungeon where the game over sequence was using the Praxis death sequence rather than the Collector’s
[*][WotA] Fixed some syncing issues with the Collector’s SFX
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with Guided Assault where it wasn’t damaging Haunted Effigies if they’re not targeted 🔥
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug with the fuses in the Simulan boss room where they could be destroyed in one hit with Serrated and the Chaos modifier active 🔥
[*][WotA] Fixed a softlock issue where players could equip Buster Ammo to different weapons in the credits minigame 🔥
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where Upgrade 2 for Summon Geo was dealing incorrect damage when combined with the generic damage upgrade
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the player’s weapon skin would not properly display after their weapon is rerolled by Bane of Expertise
[*][WotA] Fixed a bug where the Ember Buster’s Gatling mod was categorized incorrectly
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed a bug with Hailstone Armor’s Ultimate Upgrade that could cause client’s armor to desync when equipped with Midas Mail 🔥
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where Sticky Bombs would not properly explode in some cases
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed some issues with the Ultimate Upgrade for Will of the Architect where the buff was not behaving properly for clients
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where the charge animation for Will of the Architect was not properly playing
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed a bug that caused the buff granted by Upgrade 2 of Stormpike to become desynced when the skill is removed
[*][WotA] [Multiplayer] Fixed a bug where Upgrade 2 for Summon Geo was displaying additional damage numbers for clients[/list]

That's it for now. Enjoy!

-Doom Turtle

notes.title: Open Beta - Architect Fight Changes
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

A few of you have shared your thoughts about the Architect fight being a little too easy, so we've been working on some changes that we feel punch the fight up a little bit. We didn't take the fight to soul-crushing levels, but feel like the changes we did make bring a nice level of difficulty to the battle.

Before we fully roll out changes to the Architect fight, we'd like to get your feedback. If you're interested in testing these proposed changes, you'll need to opt in to a special experimental beta.


[h3][b]Instructions for Joining the Experimental Branch[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]From your Steam library, right click on Ember Knights and select [b][i]Properties...[/i][/b]
[*]On the left of the popup, click [b][i]Betas[/i][/b]
[*]In the Private Betas section, enter [b]TheArchitectIsGoingDown[/b] and click [b][i]Check Code[/i][/b]
[*]A new blue button should appear below that says [b][i]Opt into: experimental - Branch for external testing.[/i][/b] Click this button
[*]Close the popup and launch Ember Knights
[/olist]
[h3][b]Sharing Feedback[/b][/h3]
You can share feedback about the changes we've made here on Steam or in our official Discord, link below. Thank you very much!


[h3][b]Details of the Changes[/b][/h3]
[b]Architect Stats[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Move Speed[/b] - increased from 50 to 80
[*][b]HP[/b] - increased from 7000 to 12345
[*][b]Defense[/b] - increased from 10 to 20
[*][b]Magic Defense[/b] - increased from 0 to 20
[*][b]Phase 1 Cooldown[/b] - decreased from 1.0 to 0.8

[/list]

[/list]

That's everything for now. We hope you're enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/]Wrath of the Architect[/url]!

-Doom Turtle

notes.title: Hotfix Update v2.1.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

The studio is shutting down next week for a much needed break, but we wanted to get this patch out before then. You helped us identify and troubleshoot a few issues, so without further ado, here's what we included for Update 2.1.1!


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback or assistance[/i]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s collision to become disabled when skipping the Ember Dust identification cutscene
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the mimic pet to become stuck when defeating a miniboss 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where Midas Mail could cause a softlock when trying to obtain or upgrade Bone Plate 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where the player could get stuck on a black screen after beating the Architect in a Boss Rush 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where players couldn’t reconnect into Netherra with Trinity active 🔥
[*]Fixed a bunch of minor visual issues in various rooms
[*]Fixed some translation issues[/list]


That's everything for now. We hope you're enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/]Wrath of the Architect[/url] and we'll see you next year!

-Doom Turtle

notes.title: Surprise December Update!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

Before we get into the details for [b]Update 2.1[/b], we wanted to remind everyone about our Makeship Steward Plushie campaign!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/steward-ember-knights-1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/a84ec0ebfcf710431ea0e95270a43d25c948047b.png[/img][/url]

If you're interested in having your very own Steward, please check out the link below to see the campaign and pledge $2 towards your plushy. If we achieve 200 pledges, the plushies will be made! If we're unsuccessful, your $2 pledge will be refunded and the Steward will be destined to remain in the Nexus forever!

[h2][url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/steward-ember-knights-1]Makeship Steward Plushy Campaign - Pledge Here![/url][/h2]

Ok, now on to the details for [b]Update 2.1![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2] 

[h3]Skills and Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*]Molten Boulder[list][*]Updated to allow the manual detonation of the boulder for a short duration after casting[/list][*]Ronin Reflex 🔥[list][*]Updated for better clarity as to when an attack can be countered[*]Increased the window for countering an attack[*]Increased the invulnerability window after countering an attack[*]Updated to allow countering to destroy nearby projectiles[/list][*]Phantom Spear - Upgrade 2 🔥[list][*]Updated to perform an explosion at the first enemy contact and continue traveling[/list][*]Will of the Architect - Upgrade 2 🔥[list]Added energy waves to cover a greater range of damage[/list][*]Will of the Architect - Ultimate Upgrade[list]Added Judgment to the list of random skills that can be performed[/list][/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*]Relic Refinement 🔥[list][*]Improved the flow for upgrading a relic multiple times
[*]Moved relics that can't be upgraded to the bottom of the list[/list][*]Daily Dungeons[list][*]Added 35 new Dungeons[*]Increased the token rewards for difficult Dungeons[/list][*]Removed relics from the Boss Rush relic pool that aren't applicable 🔥
[*]Moved Praxis, True Praxis, and the Architect to the end of any Boss Rush they appear in
[*]Added a visual shield to Lady Inferna for when she's invulnerable during phase transitions 🔥
[*]Updated a bunch of cutscenes to only show once
[*]Increased the chance for a secret room to appear in a layout 🔥
[*]Updated Chaos Mode to ensure each first world that appears has a Skill Selector and Relic Selector in rooms 2 and 3 respectively regardless of which world appears first 🔥
[*]Reduced the speed growth on the Laser Drones 🔥
[*]Added Ash to the progress of each save slot
[*]Added unique art for each save slot
[*]Updated the DLC main menu
[*]Updated Arlan's dialogue in the DLC worlds
[*]Improved the door in the Wightsbury starting room to be more easily accessible in multiplayer games 🔥
[*]Various localization improvements 🔥[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 

Last but not least, we squashed a big bunch of bugs.
[list][*]Fixed a multiplayer softlock bug that was caused when the host would talk to Arlan while a client purchases Bob's Jar
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where Buster Ammo failed to unlock for DLC players 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where Arcane Orb failed to unlock for DLC players 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where players could travel out of bounds in the room immediately before the Architect 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where Knight's Charge would appear to end early for clients
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where the popup for Refinery could desync if the player picks up a gem 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where Guided Assault won't pierce through enemies or do damage for clients
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where Daimyo Dash appears to hit enemies it shouldn't
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where additional poison stacks were being incorrectly applied by Daimyo Dash for clients
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue with Kimokage's hitbox size for clients 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer visual issue where clients wouldn't see the counter animation from Ronin Reflex
[*]Fixed a few multiplayer visual issues related to the start of endless looping
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where the incorrect planet was showing on the loading screen when Chaos Mode is active
[*]Fixed a bug with Stormpike's lightning from Helix Sign not dealing damage
[*]Fixed a bug with Buster Ammo Upgrade 3 where the bomb would not gain a crit chance from the crit upgrade
[*]Fixed a bug where the player's health bar would disappear when exiting to the main menu while reviving 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Focus where it wasn't being applied to the Nexal Staff's starting skill 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the weaken debuff wasn't reducing boss or miniboss damage
[*]Fixed a bug with Oukranos' freeze palette not displaying
[*]Fixed an issue with Ember Blade's hitbox for its roll attack 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Summon Geo when traveling near pits or dashing
[*]Fixed an issue with Hydra where its attack indicator was not snapping to a valid summon location
[*]Fixed an issue with Hydra where it's unable to cook food
[*]Fixed an issue with Hydra where its fire breath wasn't opening the secret door in Steadfast Citadel
[*]Fixed an issue with Hydra where it couldn't open the secret door in Mycelioth if the room is currently in combat
[*]Fixed an issue with Squidling Upgrade 3 where its bonus damage is dealt much later than when the root ends
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Will of the Architect's charge and slam attacks
[*]Fixed an issue with Pyromancer where its fireballs could be destroyed by attacks while traveling
[*]Fixed a bug with Pyromancer where its fireballs could continue after killing it
[*]Fixed a bug with Pyromancer where it's able to still shoot fireballs while frozen
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Ranger to be able to immediately shoot arrows after being unfrozen
[*]Fixed a few additional and random visual issues with Pyromancer's fireballs
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Offense Bot
[*]Fixed a bug with Power Pod's sweep attack animation not being displayed
[*]Fixed a bug with Lockjaw's hitbox staying active after the chomp animation
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Jokame's projectile and VFX
[*]Fixed a bug with Jokame where it could shoot an extra projectile after being unfrozen
[*]Fixed a bug with Hannyaku where it was incorrectly dropping two gems if killed while Praxis is buffed
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Webbling Hive's burst attack indicator
[*]Fixed a bug where completing a Daily Dungeon or Boss Rush counts as clearing a run 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with projectiles in Boss Rush 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with True Praxis where he could occasionally become invulnerable in the second round of the fight 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing skills to be equipped in the first skill slot while locked by Bane of Progression
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing Elite and Champion enemies from appearing in the Compendium and counting towards the completion %
[*]Fixed an issue with a few rooms in Simulan where their bounds were incorrect
[*]Fixed a few issues with how defeated enemies were being calculated 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with the Skill Convergence's particle effects 🔥[/list]

That's it for now. We hope everyone has a lovely Christmas and holiday and wishing you all a Happy New Year!

-Doom Turtle

notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

The reception for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/]Wrath of the Architect[/url] DLC has been incredible and we're super glad you're loving the update! It makes all the hard work leading up to launch worth it!

That's it for now!

notes.title: Ember Knights: Wrath of the Architect DLC is available now!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

It's finally here! Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/776a076bfc2653adcfc4827157bbb3dd2fa6546b.png[/img]

We've been hard at work on some form of the DLC for the past year and we can't wait for you to finally get your hands on it. Ember Knights has been a passion project for the entire team here at Doom Turtle and we feel extremely grateful to be able to put together one hell of a DLC. We hope you love it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/605da8cbd002c3bb1b5b0f9b1176b77be410b318.gif[/img]

The DLC is absolutely packed with new content and features including new worlds, new bosses and minibosses, new enemies, new weapons, new skills, new relics, new curses, new secrets, new player colors, new achievements, new difficulty modifiers, and of course, the epic showdown against the Architect! PLUS, the DLC also includes everything from the free Ember Knights 2.0 update including Daily Dungeons, Boss Rush Mode, Chaos Mode, local multiplayer save and quit, more player colors, and who can forget...the beloved Nexus pets, the Ember Dog AND Ember Cat! Huge shoutout to our community for absolutely obliterating the Ember Cat challenge!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/

If you weren't already in the mood for this massive DLC, check out the brand new Wrath of the Architect trailer here:
[previewyoutube=rTHypBA6EHo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Boss Fights[/h2]
This DLC comes with 4 new bosses and 4 new minibosses. The gatekeepers of the altered new worlds will show no mercy, especially to that of a measly Ember Knight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/50ce46152c34fd3344fa14dbf623f1b6dd19cce1.gif[/img]

If you manage to survive these deadly new bosses, prepare for the ultimate showdown as you take on the creator of the entire Ember Knights universe himself - The Architect!


[h2]Weapons[/h2]
2 new weapons will be added to your repertoire - the Hyper Gloves and the Ember Buster. Both weapons offer a unique new way to defeat the legions of new enemies waiting for you in this DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/1adbc10600dce79268214a50666cbcce240f8b4c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/5ff7ad03b6c3f3f3579827272eece43f3c10129b.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Modes[/h2]
Fancy an even tougher challenge than the Architect? Stop by to see The Collector and gain access to Daily Dungeons and Boss Rush Mode. He may have even taken a page out of Arlan's book and opened up a small shop of his own!

[h3]Daily Dungeons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/ad9a428dab9331f34bee4cc108e9e704515a5dff.png[/img]
[h3]Boss Rush[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/4eb4ec90b7abd30c5123b7c1f2a974ea940c8602.gif[/img]


[h2]Price[/h2]
The Wrath of the Architect DLC is $9.99/9,99€ (or equivalent) while Ember Knights 2.0 is absolutely free.


[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]I bought the DLC, when will I get the new content? Spoilers ahead.[/b][list][*]If you're a brand new player, [spoiler]the DLC content will unlock after meeting Evee and seeing Praxis in Steadfast Citadel, the second world of the base game. [i]Note: these two conditions occur very early in the game and are required to preserve the flow of the story.[/i][/spoiler]
[*]If you're already a player, the DLC content will unlock right away.[/list][b]Does the DLC work in multiplayer?[/b][list][*]Yes[/list][b]Do my friends need to buy the DLC for us to play together?[/b][list][*]No. If the host has purchased the DLC, the team will have access to the new content. However, for a client to have the new content on their own account, they would need to purchase the DLC.[/list][b]Are the different game modes available in multiplayer?[/b][list][*]Yes[/list]

[h2]Streaming[/h2]
As usual, developers Clint and Greg will be streaming on the afternoon of release day. For specific details and to be notified when they go live, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]Discord[/url] and give yourself the @DevStream role.




We could go on and on about this update, but we'd rather you experience it for yourself. We hope you enjoy!

- Doom Turtle

notes.title: Ember Cat and Astral Ascent Collaboration Update
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

This is a bit of a surprise update since we originally planned to cease updates between 1.5 and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/]Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect[/url], but the following content could not be ignored!


[h2]EMBER CAT - GLOBAL COMMUNITY CHALLENGE[/h2]
We've heard your requests for an Ember Cat to go along with our adorable Ember Dog, so we've created a global community challenge for our players to show us that there's enough interest for an Ember Cat. If there is, we are committed to making the Ember Cat a reality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/819b19a4d6f64a603232e8993bc3985c0eb4b9e7.png[/img] 

When you first launch the 1.5.2 update, you'll see a new icon on the main menu. Opening that will provide more information as to how the challenge works. In short, just keep doing what you do - go on runs, kill enemies, kill minibosses and bosses, and earn points!
Once in the Nexus, visit the new Wanted sign that the Stewards have so carefully built. This will be your home for keeping track of your personal progress as well as the global points total.
For your individual efforts, we've added some fun new rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/b47d1e3c80c4a3e595d39648312f227caeb314fd.gif[/img]


[h2]ASTRAL ASCENT COLLABORATION[/h2]
We've been talking to the wonderful people over at Hibernian Workshop and it turns out, they're huge fans of Ember Knights! We also love what they're doing with Astral Ascent, so we decided to collaborate! We love what we've come up with and we think you will too!

Both games feature crossover content and in Ember Knights, you'll now see a cute little Yalee running around the Nexus. Interact with them and they'll give you a brand new skill - the Yalee Barrage. In addition, they'll also give you the Astral Ember Dust to unlock a brand new player color!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/4030bd3d465af3731ff6ef8ab61a5a126849f35b.gif[/img]

Also be sure to check out the latest update from Astral Ascent (also live today!) as they created their version of the Praxis fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/58acf83135132f0dc0dae4a7a39e1e76f0bd6466.gif[/img]


[h2]ACTION-PACKED ROGUELITE GEMS BUNDLE[/h2]
And finally, in addition to teaming up with Hibernian, we've also partnered with our friends at Gentle Giant and Flying Oak Games to bring you this exciting new bundle! If you haven't yet checked out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/]Astral Ascent[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835240/Spiritfall/]Spiritfall[/url], or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037020/ScourgeBringer/]ScourgeBringer[/url], now would be a great time!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44735/ActionPacked_Roguelike_Gems/


And now onto the details for 1.5.2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Ember Cat - Global Community Challenge 🔥[/h3]
Kill enemies, bosses and minibosses, variant bosses and minibosses, and find the hidden kitty on your runs and collect points to contribute towards unlocking the Ember Cat!
Also includes:[list][*]New weapon skins
[*]New cat ears cosmetic for your Knight[/list]
[h3]Astral Ascent Collaboration 🔥[/h3]
Includes the following:[list][*]New Yalee NPC
[*]New Skill - Yalee Barrage
[*]New Player Skin - Octave inspired[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 

And a few fixes are included.
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was causing the player to take an incorrect amount of damage or armor reduction when they would take damage at the same time as gaining armor 🔥
[*]Fixed an issue in multiplayer where the players could become softlocked when waking up the Mimic King 🔥
[*]Fixed an issue in multiplayer where players were unable to refine relics in the refinement selector 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues in multiplayer when a client would max out a weapon's mods before unlocking it
[*]Fixed a visual issue in multiplayer where the weapon podiums would stop glowing after the host opens the mod UI
[*]Fixed a bug where the Golden Steward could occasionally drop a charge speed gem 🔥[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

That's it for now. See everyone at the release of Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect!

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.5.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

We've heard your feedback, so we've decided to put out a small update to address some of your concerns. While we didn't roll back every change, we hit the ones that we feel are the most problematic.

Please see below for everything that's included in this hotfix patch.

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h3]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Updated Ultimate Skill Upgrades to equip automatically when any 2 upgrades for a skill have been equipped. (Reverted to previous implementation) 🔥
[*]Updated to allow skill upgrading in Scoggfirth. All Skill Selectors will include upgrades. (Reverted to previous implementation) 🔥
[*]Warrior Wisps Upgrade III - Doubled the healing. (Reverted to previous implementation) 🔥
[*]Ballista Upgrade III - Doubled the healing and removed the healing cap and cooldown. (Reverted to previous implementation) 🔥
[*]Seek and Destroy Upgrade II - Doubled the healing. (Reverted to previous implementation) 🔥
[*]Added the chance for the Golden Steward to drop additional items with his gold 🔥
[*]Removed the gold cap for additional loops when endless looping 🔥
[*]Updated the boss rewards to include Ash when defeating a boss 🔥
[*]Reduced the cost of the Refinement Shop 🔥
[*]Updated the Rainbow Player Skin to not cycle through the colors in sync with a teammate 🔥[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with saving & quitting with Quasar Orb and Nexal Staff's Arcane Mastery where the upgrades will be lost when resuming 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with saving & quitting with Cloak and Dagger and Reaper Toll's Hidden Blade where the upgrades will be lost when resuming
[*]Fixed a bug with disconnecting where Marvin's unlock sequence is triggered again 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the Rainbow player color where the icons weren't being used when saving as a preset color 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual bug where button prompts can remain visible after exiting the inventory when viewing upgrades for a skill 🔥[/list]

That's it for this hotfix patch. Thank you for your continued support!
-Doom Turtle

notes.title: For The Players Update!
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

Before we dive into the details for [b]Update 1.5 - For The Players[/b], we have some exciting news! Ember Knights has joined [b]PixElated Fest[/b], going live at 1:00 pm EST (10:00 am PST) today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/215a331d22898de6a5475dfe5d0b30c8cbd558fa.png[/img]
[i]We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Ember Knights joins PixElated Festival this week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: [url=http://pixelatedfest.com]http://pixelatedfest.com[/url]/[/i]



Ok, now on to the details for [b]Update 1.5 - For The Players![/b] Reminder, this is our last update before [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/][b]Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/574deb61721111d05b5b9a2d26da1a9a23ad3e90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/bfa19ce94329fa27b7572513ed2bbee48b07ed8d.gif[/img]

It's hard to believe that it's already been a year since we launched Ember Knights 1.0! Despite the Stewards working tirelessly to maintain the Nexus, they've also been noticing all the heroic work you've been putting in and they took the time to give you a little gift!

When you fire up 1.5, you'll see a couple Stewards ready to present you with their little token of appreciation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/168cb96a18e6da38b77039988683216de6ab228a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Save & Quit 🔥[/h3]
Quit from pretty much anywhere and be able to resume your run at a later date!

[h3]Multiplayer Improvements 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Updated a bunch of achievements and challenges in multiplayer games so clients also get credit for unlocking the achievement
[list][*][b]Weapons Training[/b] - Unlock your first new weapon
[*][b]Record Keeper[/b] - Unlock the Compendium
[*][b]A Fire Ignited[/b] - Restore Ember to the Ember Tree
[*][b]Orbs Orbs Orbs[/b] - Identify your first Relic Orb
[*][b]Strange Markings[/b] - Identify your first Skill Tablet
[*][b]Master at Arms[/b] - Unlock all weapons
[*][b]Weapon Engineer[/b] - Unlock weapon modding[/list][*]Updated to award clients with Care Package relics
[*]Updated to award clients with Mimic King's Consort for beating the minigame
[*]Updated to award clients with Bob's Containment Field for completing the broken jar sequence
[*]Updated so clients get credit for discovering relic orbs
[*]Updated to still spawn skill tablets if any of the players still need it
[*]Updated the Marvin sequence so it plays any sequences that have not been seen by a client
[*]Updated to allow players to use their last equipped weapon
[*]Updated the player select screen to support choosing your player color from your color presets
[*]Added Rejoin to the multiplayer menu in the Main Menu
[*]Updated Steam invites to support reconnects
[*]Updated the HUD so the player’s is always on the left
[*]Updated the HUD and boss health bars to hide when the player runs behind them
[*]Updated the Options menu and added a settings tab[/list]
[h3]Revive Improvements 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Automatic revives after 3 combat rooms
[*]Updated the HUD to display the correct revive message[/list]
[h3]Visual Clarity Improvements 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Updated the player indicator to show a ring and arrow that match the player’s flame color
[list][*]Added a toggle in the Options menu to turn this on or off[/list][*]Added a dimmer to the Options menu for adjusting the opacity of the HUD[/list]
[h3]Mouse Functionality Improvements 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Added mouse functionality to all remaining screens
[list][*]Selectors (skill, relic, stat)
[*]Relic refinement selector and shop
[*]Dialogue advancing
[*]Ember Shrine
[*]Offering Pit
[*]Cinematic replay[/list][/list]
[h3]Ember Tree UI Improvements 🔥[/h3]
We reworked the Ember Tree UI to look more like the Ember Shrine and function like the weapon modding UI. We also added your current upgrades to the Ember Tree tooltip, so you no longer need to open the UI just to see what upgrades you have equipped.

[h3]Golden Steward[/h3]
As a fun little bonus, you can now encounter Goldie throughout a run. Defeat this glittery little loot Steward and he'll be sure to reward you with his stash of gold!

[h3]Special Anniversary Steward Gift & New Player Color 🔥[/h3]
It's been about a year since we released 1.0 and the Stewards have been paying attention to all your hard work over this past year. They've worked really hard on a neat little present for you and it can be found on your first visit back to the Nexus!


[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2] 

Before we talk about the balancing changes, we'd like to extend a heartfelt thanks for everyone that tested these changes on the experimental beta branch and provided their thoughts. The feedback was incredibly valuable! ❤️

[h3]Skills 🔥[/h3]
[list][*][strike]Updated ultimate upgrades to no longer automatically equip after 2 upgrades are equipped[/strike][list][*][i]Being reverted in Hotfix 1.5.1[/i][/list][*][strike]Removed upgrade options from the skill selectors in Scoggfirth[/strike][list][*][i]Being reverted in Hotfix 1.5.1[/i][/list][*]Updated a bunch of individual upgrades:[list][*][b]Blast Bomb Upgrade III[/b] - Reduced damage on the 3 bombs by 50%
[*][b]Knight's Charge Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Requires hitting unique enemies to refresh
[*][strike][b]Warrior Wisps Upgrade III[/b] - Reduced healing by 50%[/strike][list][*][i]Being reverted in Hotfix 1.5.1[/i][/list][*][b]Hailstone Armor Upgrade III[/b] - Invulnerability clears after 4s or when you attack or cast another skill
[*][b]Ballista Upgrade II[/b] - Reduced damage on the 3 arrows by 33%
[*][strike][b]Ballista Upgrade III[/b] - Reduced healing from 2 to 1 with a maximum of 15 HP per Ballista. Added a 5s cooldown[/strike][list][*][i]Being reverted in Hotfix 1.5.1[/i][/list][*][b]Judgment Upgrade I[/b] - Reduced damage on the additional set of lightning bolts by 50%
[*][strike][b]Seek and Destroy Upgrade II[/b] - Reduced healing by 50%[/strike][list][*][i]Being reverted in Hotfix 1.5.1[/i][/list][*][b]Cloak and Dagger Upgrade I[/b] - Reduced damage on the 3 daggers by 33%
[*][b]Arlan's Lucky Dice Upgrade I[/b] - Set a limit of 1 food item and 1 stat gem per room
[*][b]Arlan's Lucky Dice Upgrade II[/b] - Set a limit of 2 Wisps and 1 Ballista. Additional rolls will replace the current Wisp or Ballista
[*][b]Arlan's Lucky Dice Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Updated to require a perfect cast. Second dice deals 75% damage
[*][b]Soul Siphon Upgrade II[/b] - Reduced damage on additional lasers by 50%
[*][b]Gravity Well Upgrade I[/b] - Reduced the range of the laser. Updated the distance to be controlled by the charge time[/list][/list]
[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list][*]Updated the following relics:[list][*][b]Spell in a Bottle[/b][list][*]Removed the ability for the projectiles from this relic to refresh skills
[*]Reduced projectile damage from 25 to 15[/list][*][b]Magic Tome[/b][list][*]Reduced AOE damage from 25 to 20[/list][*][b]Pristine Band[/b][list][*]Reduced base health gain from 5 to 3[*]Reduced max owned from 5 to 4[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*]Suppression Obelisk changed from lifetime to hit counter
[*]Added a skill selector or relic refinement to empty secret rooms 🔥
[*]Added number of loops and chain of perfect rooms to the summary screen 🔥
[*]Added a windowed option 🔥
[*]Reduced the volume on the company logos 🔥[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 

Last but not least, we fixed a few pesky bugs.
[list][*]Fixed a bug where killing enemies wasn’t updating the relic orb enemy kill counter on the save slot 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies could become pulled before finishing their spawn animation 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Praxis where he could occasionally teleport out of the room 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Shared Fate and Praxis buffed enemies where players would take more damage than they should 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Effigeist where his HP would increase after being frozen
[*]Fixed a bug with Hypercharger where his attack indicators could become displaced
[*]Fixed a bug with Hailstone Armor’s Ultimate Upgrade where the ice ring could permanently freeze elite and champion enemies 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Judgment’s Ultimate Upgrade where Praxis could take damage when he’s no longer visible in the room 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues with cursed relics and their cleansed versions where they weren’t being tracked consistently in the Compendium 🔥
[*]Fixed some minor visual issues with the Knight when equipped with the Rift Hammer
[*]Fixed a bug where skipping a selection in a selector could cause the game timer to resume ticking 🔥
[*]Fixed a few multiplayer bugs related to the intro sequences for Praxis
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where clients would only take 1 damage from Defense Bot’s projectile attack 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where clients could identify Soul Siphon and Gravity Well again if the host hasn’t unlocked them yet 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where some clients could not see the destroyed Volt buff
[*]Fixed a bug where the button mapping for skill upgrade details wasn’t appearing (Switch only) 🔥[/list]


That's it for now. See everyone at the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/][b]Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect![/b][/url]
[b]Remember to wishlist the DLC to stay up to date with all the latest news![/b]

-Doom Turtle

As usual, if you want to stay on top of the news, see new content before it's live, share your favourite memes, or simply chat strategy about the best weapons and skills, join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions as we work towards a massive 2024 so be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with us!

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.4.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

How are you liking the [b]Skills Mastery Update[/b]?
We've seen the videos and screenshots of some of the busted upgrade combinations (*cough* Dice *cough*) so rest assured, we'll be looking to make some balancing changes in 1.5. Until then, we hope you have fun with them!

Now, no update is complete without a few annoying bugs, so we decided to put out a patch to address them!
Please see below for everything that's included in this hotfix patch.

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h3]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Reduced the cost in half for unlocking skill upgrades
[*]Decreased the attack speed on the Praxis hands attack 🔥
[*]Decreased the attack speed and reduced the number of lasers on the Praxis lasers attack 🔥[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the player could become softlocked when killing a miniboss with Soul Siphon and having its third upgrade equipped 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues related to bosses and relics, mods, or upgrades that spawn projectiles when refreshing a skill where the boss could take damage during its intro potentially causing a softlock 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where a softlock could occur when one player has Brittle Scepter and another freezes an enemy with a perfect Frost Wall 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where a softlock could occur if the host defeats a miniboss with Rupture’s Ultimate upgrade 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Warrior Wisps and its third upgrade where players could become excessively healed 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the ice rings from Frost Wall and Hailstone Armor wouldn’t damage or freeze Rakkling Nests
[*]Fixed a bug with Gravity Well and its first upgrade where it would spawn a projectile
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing locked skill slots to be upgraded
[*]Fixed a bug with the Oooh Shiny! achievement where it was unlocking without unlocking all the mods for a weapon 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing Invigorate from granting 20% attack speed
[*]Fixed a bug with Razor Wind’s Empowered mod where it was applying 6 stacks instead of 5
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing Cloak and Dagger’s Ultimate upgrade from applying the proper amount of damage on crits
[*]Fixed a bug with Void Mantle’s Laser Focus mod where it could cast dark spells multiple times 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the exit door in the Credits minigame
[*]Fixed some visual issues with various player auras where the visual effects would continue after the player dies
[*]Fixed a bug where additional meteors could be seen by clients in multiplayer games 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual issue where the revive message was not properly displaying for defeating a miniboss or boss
[*]Fixed a few font issues that would occur when switching between languages
[*]Fixed a few UI issues that were happening in various languages[/list]

That's it for this hotfix patch. Thank you for your continued support!
-Doom Turtle

Fixed some visual issues with various player auras where the visual effects would continue after the player dies
Fixed a bug where additional meteors could be seen by clients in multiplayer games 🔥
Fixed a visual issue where the revive message was not properly displaying for defeating a miniboss or boss
Fixed a few font issues that would occur when switching between languages
Fixed a few UI issues that were happening in various languages

notes.title: Skills Mastery Update
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

Before we dive into the Skills Mastery Update, we have some huge news!

[h2]Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/5c865faea4bc091774871d2a6766a19a01f92a29.gif[/img]

[h3]The store page for Ember Knights 2.0 - Wrath of the Architect is now live![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/

[h3]We'll be updating the DLC page as we continue with the development and the best way to stay on top of the news is by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948140/Ember_Knights__Wrath_of_the_Architect/][b]Wishlisting[/b][/url]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/89a4069dbded342a8c452ffb3a4f8e1de298b99c.gif[/img]


Ok, now on to the [b]Skills Mastery Update[/b] details!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/bed0e47257a0cd741ed577bd0096ff50161d22de.png[/img]

[h1]Skill Upgrading[/h1]
Skill upgrades are something we've wanted to implement for awhile now so here we go! With Evee's help, every skill can be upgraded in multiple ways and once they're unlocked, they can be equipped in any order.
Mix and match upgrades for awesome and powerful synergies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/e529ed9f4ebd25e12b2cb0b21f2630fde02117dc.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/7cda1ad2f20ca060197c816e6bd08387a386f972.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/46d3a03e3fada95674fc964fd927c8c7f108296b.gif[/img]


[h1]PAX Competition Mode[/h1]
The PAX Competition was such a big success in Boston that we decided to make it available for everyone! Access the new mode via the Main Menu! 

[previewyoutube=Nrag361DVY4;full][/previewyoutube]
Be sure to practice as we'll be introducing some contests related to the Competition Mode closer to 2.0!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Skill Upgrades[/h3]
Upgrades include 3 specific upgrades and 1 Ultimate upgrade for each skill as well as a handful of general upgrades that can be applied to any skill.

[h3]General Upgrades[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade 1[/b] - Increases crit chance
[*][b]Upgrade 2[/b] - Increases damage
[*][b]Upgrade 3[/b] - Adds 1 additional charge
[*][b]Upgrade 4[/b] - Defeating an enemy with a skill heals
[*][b]Upgrade 5[/b] - Reduces the number of hits to refresh[/list][h3]Ember Fire[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Increases the range
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Burst an additional cone of mystical flame behind the Knight
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Shoots 3 fireballs in a spread shot
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever you burn an enemy with Ember Fire, your burn effects deal increased damage[/list][h3]Blast Bomb[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Enemies hit by your Blast Bomb are rooted
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Your bombs pull enemies towards them before exploding
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Throws 3 bombs in a row
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Bombs explode into 3 smaller cluster bombs[/list][h3]Arcane Bolts[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Your bolts become ghosts. Whenever you defeat an enemy with a ghost bolt, another is summoned to seek and damage additional enemies
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Your bolts are imbued with a random element of burn, freeze, poison, or lightning
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Your bolts release in an expanding circle
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Arcane Bolts refreshes quicker[/list][h3]Rupture[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - The ground is ruptured dealing damage over time
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Rupture, the outer ring is cast an additional time
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - You gain Max HP for each enemy defeated by Rupture. Enemies have a chance to turn into a potato
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Enemies below a certain HP are instantly defeated by Rupture[/list][h3]Chakram[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Increases crit chance of Chakram. Whenever Chakram crits, it freezes
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Whenever Chakram bounces off the Knight, their next weapon attack is a guaranteed crit
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Chakram, your first hit is a crit
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Chakram hits count towards refreshing skills[/list][h3]Knight's Charge[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Knight's Charge, a meteor is summoned at the target location that deals damage and burn
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Leaves a trail of fire that burns enemies
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Your Knight's Charge is a decoy projectile that stuns enemies
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever 3 or more enemies are hit by a perfect Knight's Charge, it refreshes[/list][h3]Warrior Wisps[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Increases max Wisps by 1. Wisps no longer have a lifetime
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - You gain weapon damage for each Wisp you have
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever a Wisp is defeated, each Knight is healed
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Increases damage, speed, and HP for all Wisps[/list][h3]Frost Wall[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Whenever an enemy is defeated by Frost Wall, they explode dealing damage and freeze enemies behind them
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Increases Frost Wall damage and freezes enemies that contact the Frost Wall
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Your Frost Wall is an expanding ice ring dealing damage and freeze
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Your Frost Wall permanently freezes elite and champion enemies[/list][h3]Cyclone[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - You gain move speed for each active Cyclone
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Whenever a Cyclone dies, lightning is summoned
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Your Cyclone stays with the Knight and no longer pulls enemies
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Chunks of earth are thrown dealing damage[/list][h3]Hailstone Armor[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Thrown snowballs create an ice spike dealing AOE damage around the target
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Gain a passive aura that slows enemies around you
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Hailstone Armor, you become temporarily invulnerable
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Hailstone Armor, you gain armor. Also releases a frost nova that freezes[/list][h3]Ballista[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Your Ballista is imbued with a random element of burn, freeze, poison, or lightning
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Your Ballista shoots a spread of 3 arrows
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever an enemy is damaged by Ballista, you heal
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Ballista can be picked up. Whenever it's picked up, it refreshes[/list][h3]Phantom Spear[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Deals bonus damage for each poisoned enemy
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Your Phantom Spear explodes dealing AOE damage
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Enemies hit by Phantom Spear are dealt max poison stacks
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Enemies hit by Phantom Spear are haunted and spawn a ghost when defeated by Phantom Spear[/list][h3]Arcane Orb[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Arcane Orb refreshes quicker
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Arcane Orb is a cone of damage
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever Arcane Orb refreshes, 3 seeking orbs are summoned
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever charging, multiple seeking orbs are released[/list][h3]Judgment[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Summons an additional set of lightning bolts
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Enemies in the cast radius are rooted
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever you cast a perfect Judgment, your next 6 weapon attacks have lightning
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Gain a static aura that deals AOE damage[/list][h3]Seek and Destroy[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Your drill stays in place and deals AOE damage
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Whenever an enemy is defeated with your drill, each Knight is healed
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Enemies hit by your drill are rooted
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Your drill will seek indefinitely until it fails to defeat a target[/list][h3]Cloak and Dagger[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Your Dagger is replaced with 3 Daggers that attack in a cone
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Whenever entering or exiting invisibility, conjure up to 3 lightning bolts
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - While invisible, unleash ghosts to seek and damage enemies. Enemies hit by your Dagger attack are haunted
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever entering or exiting invisibility, your next weapon attack is a guaranteed crit and deals increased damage
[/list][h3]Arlan's Lucky Dice[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Rolling a 1 also conjures a food and rolling a 2 also conjures a gem
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Rolling a 3 also summons a Wisp and rolling a 4 also summons a Ballista
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - The chance of rolling a 5 or 6 are doubled
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Rolls a second of Arlan's Lucky Dice[/list][h3]Soul Siphon[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Whenever an enemy is defeated by Soul Siphon, it refreshes quicker
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Conjures 3 beams
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Enemies defeated by Soul Siphon leave a damage AOE where they were defeated
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever Soul Siphon refreshes, permanently increase skill damage[/list][h3]Gravity Well[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Conjure a beam to pierce and pull enemies towards a black hole
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Enemies hit by Gravity Well are frozen and no longer stunned
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Gravity Well ends with an explosion of chain lightning that seeks other enemies
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Gravity Well destroys enemy projectiles[/list][h3]Quasar Orbs[/h3]
[list][*][b]Upgrade I[/b] - Quasar Orbs refreshes quicker
[*][b]Upgrade II[/b] - Your Quasar Orbs deals 3 cones of damage
[*][b]Upgrade III[/b] - Whenever Quasar Orbs refreshes, 3 seeking orbs are summoned
[*][b]Ultimate Upgrade[/b] - Whenever charging, multiple seeking orbs are released[/list]

[h3]Skill Upgrade Achievements[/h3]
[list][*][b]Apprentice[/b] - Unlock skill upgrading
[*][b]Shaman[/b] - Unlock all upgrades for a skill
[*][b]Wizard[/b] - Unlock all upgrades for all skills[/list]

[h3]PAX Competition Mode 🔥[/h3]
Access this fun new game mode via the Main Menu!


[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2] 

In addition to the new content and features, we’ve also made the following changes.
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Increased the presence of skill rooms in all map layouts[/list][*][b]Eruption[/b][list][*]Renamed to Seek and Destroy
[*]Updated travel distance based on charge amount
[*]Added a knock-up to enemies in its travel path
[*]Added a burst of AOE damage to the end of its travel path
[*]Updated to seek another enemy if an enemy is killed with its AOE damage[/list][*][b]Cloak and Dagger[/b][list][*]Updated the HUD to show the time left for being invisible
[*]Updated to allow the Dagger portion of the attack to be used with the attack button while invisible[/list][/list]
[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Increased frequency of legendary relics appearing
[*]Added the ability to upgrade relics that are limited to being owned by one player. Applies to Pristine Band and Withercore[/list][*][b]Pyroguard - New Relic[/b][list][*]"Enemies that you burn deal reduced damage"[*]Epic rarity[*]Damage reduction of 20%[*]Max owned of 1[/list][*][b]Empowered Bangle[/b][list][*]Reworked to "Your first skill hit on an enemy deals skill damage"[*]Damage of 30 * skill damage %[*]Damage growth of 10[*]Max owned of 2[/list][*][b]Shock Troop[/b][list][*]Reworked to "Whenever you defeat an enemy with lightning, you gain armor."[*]Increases max armor of 10 on pickup[*]Armor gain of 3[*]Max armor growth of 5[*]Max owned of 4[/list][*][b]Withercore[/b][list][*]Reworked to "Whenever a player defeats a poisoned enemy, they drop a Withering Core that heals"[*]Healing growth of 2[*]Max owned of 4[*]Dropped item applies to all players[*]Can only be equipped by one player[/list][*][b]Creature's Bond[/b][list][*]Reworked to add flat bonus damage to Wisps[*]Damage of 15[*]Damage growth of 10[*]Increased duration from 6s to from 1 to 10[*]Increased growth from 1 to 5[/list][*][b]Glacier Necklace[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 5 to 15[*]Increased growth from 5 to 10[/list][*][b]Plasma Ball[/b][list][*]Increased proc chance from 25% to 75%[*]Max stacks of 2 for 100% chance[/list][*][b]Shocking Revelation[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 3-15 to 15-30[/list][*][b]Flawless Brace[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 25% to 30%[/list][*][b]Pristine Band[/b][list][*]Increased HP from 1 to 5[*]Increased growth from 1 to 2[*]Increased max owned from 4 to 5[*]Can only be equipped by one player[/list][*][b]Decayed Scepter[/b][list][*]Increased skill damage from 15% to 50%[*]Increased poison stacks from 1/2/3 to 3/4/5[/list][*][b]Surge Pendant[/b][list][*]Increased bonus skill damage from 50% to 75%[*]Increased max owned from 2 to 4[*]Increased duration from 3s to 8s[/list][*][b]Magic Tome[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 5 to 25[*]Increase growth from 5 to 10[/list][*][b]Spell in a Bottle[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 15 to 25[*]Increased max owned from 1 to 4[*]Increased base projectiles from 1 to 2[*]Added projectile growth of 1[*]Increased frequency of appearing[/list][*][b]Meteor[/b][list][*]Increased HP threshold from 20% to 50%[/list][*][b]Ornate Glove[/b][list][*]Increased bonus stats from 5% to 10%[/list][*][b]Steel Mace[/b][list][*]Increased bonus damage multiplier from 50% to 100%[/list][*][b]Clobbering Mace[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 25 to 40[*]Decreased growth from 25 to 15[/list][*][b]Ember lifetime[/list][/list]
[h3]Curses[/h3]
[list][*][b]Bane of the Deal[/b][list][*]Updated to preserve rarity on swap[/list][*][b]Boon of Shrouding[/b][list][*]Updated to apply to all players[/list][/list]
[h3]Void Mantle[/h3]
[list][*][b]Dark Clone[/b][list][*]Cooldown resets when entering a new room[/list][*][b]Charge Attack[/b][list][*]Reduced charge time based on the number of orbs that are stored[*]Removed charge requirement when 5 orbs are already stored[/list][*][b]Dark Spells[/b][list][*]Prioritized enemies hit by the charge attack[*]Removing targeting on invulnerable enemies[/list][*][b]Dark Spell: Black Hole[/b][list][*]Increased damage from 30 to 50[*]Updated to work like Darkening. Deals base damage or 10% enemy health damage; whichever is higher[*]Updated visuals[/list][b]Dark Spell: Celestial Tear[/b][list][*]Removed requirement of hitting an enemy to activate[/list][/list]
[h3]Scoggfirth[/h3]
[list][*][b]Champion Rotworm[/b][list][*]Reduced spawn count[/list][/list]
[h3]Wightsbury[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Added a green glow to indicate when the next room is a Wight room[/list][*][b]Pox Rat[/b][list][*]Reduced attack speed[*]Reduced range[*]Reduced number of projectiles[/list][*][b]Weald Wolf[/b][list][*]Added a max spawn count[/list][/list]
[h3]Anville[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced the number of traps[*]Reduced the max number of supercharged enemies[*]Various visual improvements[/list][*][b]Cleaver[/b][list][*]Reduced range to match its champion version[*]Reduced attack radius[/list][*][b]Shocker[/b][list][*]Added a max speed to its chase attack[/list][*][b]Defense Bot[/b][list][*]Reduced active range for its projectile attack[/list][/list]
[h3]Champion Enemies[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced HP on various champions[*]Reduced the number of additional enemies that can spawn during the fight[/list][*][b]Champion Rotworm[/b][list][*]Reduced the number of regular Rotworms[*]Removed the additional spawning of regular Rotworms[/list][/list]
[h3]Tyrant Difficulty Mod[/h3]
[list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced attack speed[*]Decreased spawn rate for some attacks[*]Improved attack visuals[*]Updated to show Praxis with each attack[/list][*][b]Void Vortex[/b][list][*]Added a short delay before attack[*]Improved attack visuals[/list][/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted and balanced the HP of most enemies[*]A bunch of memory optimizations and improvements 🔥[*]Various localization improvements 🔥[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 

Last but not least, we fixed a bunch of issues.
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was preventing some weapon challenges from being completed if a player is dead when a boss is defeated 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug that could cause a crash if a client is webbed when Arachna Za dies 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug that was preventing players from reconnecting in Netherra if all the stat gem rooms were cleared
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing players to get stuck when their controller disconnects the moment a boss is defeated and the north door opens 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual issue with Praxis where he would leap offscreen if he loses his target at the start of his claw attack
[*]Fixed a bug with Guardian Angel where Praxis enemies could still kill the player 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was occasionally causing frozen enemies to appear invisible when spawning 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the SFX for the Healing Fountain would stop playing
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the SFX from playing for the Ember Blade’s Whirlwind mod
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the Ember Dust popup from appearing for A Greater Power
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the player to get softlocked if skipping the Ember Dust unlock sequence before identifying a Skill with Evee 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the Suppression Obelisk to spawn when exiting a secret room 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the glow of an enemy to turn white when stunned
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the Doom Shell to stop spinning on the double roll
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the VFX from appearing on Shade’s leap attack
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing animations on the tear in the Architect’s Realm to stop playing
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing DoT attacks to stop the Whirmaw from doing its spin attack
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Aim Assist to target the invincible traps in the Overtime Scrapper’s room 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the Rift Hammer’s Combat Slam from converting apples into apple sauce 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was only pausing the Mimic King’s record player after being hit 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues with boss health bars while having Pantheon active 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues with navigating the Ember Tree UI 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues with navigating the Weapon Mod UI 🔥[/list]

That's it for now. Thank you for your continued support!
-Doom Turtle

- Upgrade III - Enemies hit by your drill are rooted
- Ultimate Upgrade - Your drill will seek indefinitely until it fails to defeat a target
- Upgrade I - Your Dagger is replaced with 3 Daggers that attack in a cone
- Upgrade II - Whenever entering or exiting invisibility, conjure up to 3 lightning bolts
- Upgrade III - While invisible, unleash ghosts to seek and damage enemies. Enemies hit by your Dagger attack are haunted
- Ultimate Upgrade - Whenever entering or exiting invisibility, your next weapon attack is a guaranteed crit and deals increased damage
- Upgrade I - Rolling a 1 also conjures a food and rolling a 2 also conjures a gem
- Upgrade II - Rolling a 3 also summons a Wisp and rolling a 4 also summons a Ballista
- Upgrade III - The chance of rolling a 5 or 6 are doubled
- Ultimate Upgrade - Rolls a second of Arlan's Lucky Dice
- Upgrade I - Whenever an enemy is defeated by Soul Siphon, it refreshes quicker
- Upgrade II - Conjures 3 beams
- Upgrade III - Enemies defeated by Soul Siphon leave a damage AOE where they were defeated
- Ultimate Upgrade - Whenever Soul Siphon refreshes, permanently increase skill damage
- Upgrade I - Conjure a beam to pierce and pull enemies towards a black hole
- Upgrade II - Enemies hit by Gravity Well are frozen and no longer stunned
- Upgrade III - Gravity Well ends with an explosion of chain lightning that seeks other enemies
- Ultimate Upgrade - Gravity Well destroys enemy projectiles
- Upgrade I - Quasar Orbs refreshes quicker
- Upgrade II - Your Quasar Orbs deals 3 cones of damage
- Upgrade III - Whenever Quasar Orbs refreshes, 3 seeking orbs are summoned
- Ultimate Upgrade - Whenever charging, multiple seeking orbs are released
- Apprentice - Unlock skill upgrading
- Shaman - Unlock all upgrades for a skill
- Wizard - Unlock all upgrades for all skills
Access this fun new game mode via the Main Menu!
