notes.title: Nexus News - PAX East, Upcoming Updates, and New Game Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings, Knights!


It’s been a minute since our last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1135230/view/3650785607773403081]Nexus News[/url] but rest assured, we’ve been as busy as ever!

2024 is going to be a massive year for Doom Turtle but before we dive into the huge new updates, let’s talk about our recent trip to Boston for PAX East!

[h2]PAX EAST[/h2]
This was the first time that we attended a PAX event and without exaggeration, it was amazing. To be able to meet and chat with so many passionate Ember Knights players was an incredible experience! We talked about new content and features, ran a bunch of exciting competitions, gave away a ton of keys, and even posed for a picture or two!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/cb1615374512ca4fba8a9b48e41606753f87efe6.png[/img][i]Jeff recruiting some potential Razor Wind players...[/i]

[previewyoutube=l746jBmVgyQ;full][/previewyoutube][i]The crowd waiting for the next Ember Knights competition[/i]

[previewyoutube=Nrag361DVY4;full][/previewyoutube][i]The special competition mode we made for PAX East[/i]


[previewyoutube=pdJahnfX1gY;full][/previewyoutube][i]Jeff and Greg giving away free copies of Ember Knights to all the winners[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]NEW GAME - LEGENDS OF STARKADIA[/h2]

But, we didn't dedicate our booth to [i]just[/i] Ember Knights. We also unveiled our newest game, [b]Legends of Starkadia[/b]!

Around the time we launched Ember Knights 1.0, we split our small studio into 2 even smaller teams. While half of us have been continuing to support Ember Knights, half of us have been working on Legends of Starkadia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f04e9d4c2125e0b7a2927488875ff66db3354e8f.png[/img]
[quote]When one bored Earthling teen is accidentally teleported to the far flung Starkadian Empire, he lands face first in the middle of an interdimensional battle between good and evil, with the fate of the universe at stake! Now it’s up to him and a ragtag bunch of misfits to defeat the shadowy, extradimensional armies of the Empire and become the heroes the system needs.[/quote]
[h3][b]Check out the Steam page and [u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618160/Legends_of_Starkadia/]Wishlist Now![/url][/u][/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618160/Legends_of_Starkadia/

[h3][b]Keep an eye out for our public demo, coming later this year![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

And now, let's [b]look into the Shadows[/b] of what we've been working on for Ember Knights!

[h2]UPDATE 1.4 - SKILLS MASTERY[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/bed0e47257a0cd741ed577bd0096ff50161d22de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/24c350deb4fbd7fe552b371dc19c092a2d1e6a7b.gif[/img]

Stay alert as you fight your way through Wightsbury as there's a strange new crystal floating around and it'll be this very crystal that Evee needs to finally upgrade her Skill Convergence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f5397f689232374ca82c0a4f2e5dd1c2bfd20f10.png[/img]
Once you've unlocked Skill Upgrading, you'll be able to use your Ash to unlock various upgrades for each skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/441e1f0b63180d5735acc745e0a5aeb4c4c0b945.png[/img]
Once an upgrade has been unlocked, it can now appear in Skill Rooms and Skill Selectors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/7af04df20e4c598198d93f7190c0ef3789be324a.png[/img]
Here, we have good old White Knight showing off their fancy new Ember Fire upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/969eb56c4d10964ffe36cb481ace85b20f5c0799.gif[/img]

But that's not all!

Combine upgrades to create powerful new synergies! Disclaimer: not responsible for adverse effects to your player color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/9d33c3d8912e8c3c44bad03babbe848d5c0726b5.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The Skills Mastery Update goes live May 13th![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]UPDATE 1.5 - FOR THE PLAYERS[/h2]
This is the update before [b]THE[/b] update and the perfect opportunity to tie off any loose ends.

Have you been wanting a particular feature that hasn't made its way into the game?
Do you keep seeing a cool new idea that seems like an obvious addition?
Are you wondering if we even read all the player suggestions?
Well, we do and this could be the update for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/8bd6645490f3053bb0a0e611b19abd8b48523c25.png[/img]

The [b]For The Players Update[/b] is the update where we're putting in some of the most requested features and that includes the number one player requested feature, the much coveted [b]Save & Quit[/b]!
That's right, endless looping will now be a lot less daunting as you battle to restore peace to the universe, take a well-deserved break, and then return to repeat the work fit for a hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]PUSH TO 4000 REVIEWS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/965d8a41a80a7f63975055d2458334a657aa11d1.png[/img]

We'd like to take a moment to express our gratitude for the incredible reception that Ember Knights has received. Because of all the support, we've been able to continue to put out packed update after packed update with it all culminating in our massive 2.0 DLC Update coming later this year!

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you so much for everything! ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

Oh, one more thing before we dive back into the [b]Shadows[/b]...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/07a1fdc0e835141d56444c33d6e08552ae46b672.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f946878ca047b1bb9c4734c40b260cfe1b5763d7.gif[/img]

See [b]You[/b] soon!

- Doom Turtle

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.3.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

We hope everyone is enjoying all the new content and features in the [b]Praxis Returns Update![/b]

As usual, we've found a few minor issues and felt it was better to get them fixed now rather than waiting for Update 1.4, our next scheduled update. 
Please see below for everything that's included in this hotfix patch!

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback and help[/i]


[h3]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted the values on the following difficulty modifiers:
[list][*][b]Horde, Ruin (previously Bane), Haste[/b]
[list][*]Tier 1 - No change
[*]Tier 2 - No change
[*]Tier 3 - 200% > 225%
[*]Tier 4 - No change[/list][*][b]Onslaught[/b]
[list][*]Tier 1 - 115% > 125%
[*]Tier 2 - 135% > 150%
[*]Tier 3 - 150% > 175%
[*]Tier 4 - No change[/list][/list][*]Renamed difficulty modifier Bane to Ruin
[*]Updated Ultembera to shoot projectiles for all the Rift Hammer attacks
[*]Updated the visuals for Pristine Band and Absolute Ambition to only play one instance of the effect despite multiple players having the same relic
[*]Added a function to sync in-game achievements with Steam achievements in the event of a discrepancy
[*]Added and updated some minor SFX[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with Laser Focus and Celestial Tear where it was possible to cast Celestial Tear without charging all the orbs 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Void Mantle and Grim Duality where standing next to the armor stand in the refinement shop causes it to take rapid damage 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Dark Clone and Ghostly Image or Phantom Pulse where it was triggering Supreme Ambition 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with price of the Void Mantle mods
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the Void Mantle orbs where the VFX can get turned off when skipping cutscenes in Netherra 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with Void Mantle on the awards screen and Netherra’s 8 portal clear buff 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the HUD version of the Void Mantle 🔥
[*]Fixed a few issues with the Praxis fight where he could keep a status effect after the first phase
[*]Fixed a visual bug with Oakbane where it was showing a different palette when frozen 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with the environment art in Netherra
[*]Fixed an issue with Bane of Shrouding where it wouldn’t properly snap to the player in wider screen resolutions
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with with Banes and Boons in shops
[*]Fixed an issue where toggling the HUD off and on while a skill slot is locked would cause the locked slot to no longer appear
[*]Fixed another visual issue with the skill slot where dying and reconnecting after a skill disabler would cause the slot to flash the lock animation
[*]Fixed a visual bug on the game over screen where it would only show the Ember Blade icon when unlocking the Amplified skin for other weapons 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug in endless looping where Praxis was not returning on subsequent loops to apply his additional attacks 🔥
[/list]

That's it for now. Thank you for your continued support!
-Doom Turtle


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]


[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

As always, if you want to stay on top of the news, see new content before it's live, share your favorite memes, or simply chat strategy about the best weapons and skills, join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions as we work towards a massive 2024 so be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/609473260832423967/609473261314637854]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with us!

[i]Stay tuned for more news and updates![/i]

notes.title: Praxis Returns Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/51e2fb671770bb5a4a5646343182814fc3898190.png[/img]

Hello Knights!

And Happy New Year!
We hope everyone is ready to start 2024 off with the action-packed [b]Praxis Returns Update![/b]
The evil influence of Praxis is stronger than ever!

Take a look below for everything that this massive update includes!


[h1]Void Mantle[/h1]
With the constant threat of Praxis rising, we felt it was necessary to add another weapon, inspired by the evil one himself.
Harness the powers of Praxis with the all new [b]Void Mantle![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/cd39cec6d92ecef0aff002066cfa171a4cdb88e7.gif[/img]
[i]Note: Since the Void Mantle harnesses the powers of Praxis, you'll need to defeat Praxis to unlock it. If you've already defeated Praxis, it should automatically be available.[/i]


[h1]Praxis Curses[/h1]
Wightsbury just became more deadly...and more interesting? Here, you'll find curses - each bringing a new challenge to your plight, but don't fret, once the curse has been equipped, you'll also receive an immediate benefit. After the curse has been cleared, the unique benefit will persist for the rest of your run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/e98bd0847de9b031c3fcb2bab863ce68b15e65bc.png[/img]
See below for a specific functionality that was removed but has since been returned in the form of a cleansed curse!


[h1]Praxis Effects[/h1]
In addition to the Praxis-buffed enemies, we've added a bunch of new and deadly attacks that Praxis can do throughout your run to keep you on your toes. These random attacks add a noticeable increase to the difficulty so we've decided to add this feature as a new difficulty modifier. If you want this additional challenge, be sure to turn this modifier on and if not, no sweat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/185dd5d79a521cd6392ccc355190a6142b0ee965.png[/img]


[h1]Weapon Challenges, Skins, & Achievements[/h1]
Weapon customization is a feature we've had requested quite a bit and we loved the idea so much that we decided to add it!
Complete a special weapon challenge to unlock a unique weapon skin and brand new Steam achievement! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/d69d0f8361dbd691ea776746e3d6197008106ffc.png[/img]


[h1]And much more![/h1]
This is another massive update so continue reading for the full list of additions, improvements, and fixes!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Void Mantle[/h3]
The 7th weapon has arrived and it introduces a fun new way to continue the battle against Praxis!
[h3]Void Mantle Mods[/h3]
[list][*][b]Orb Burst[/b] - Your 3rd attack shoots 2 additional orbs
[*][b]Orb Weaver[/b] - Your chain attacks have seeking
[*][b]Laser Focus[/b] - Your charge attack is now a laser beam
[*][b]Dark Spell: Dark Star[/b] - A dark spell that creates a black hole and casts meteor
[*][b]Dark Spell: Celestial Tear[/b] - A dark spell that instantly kills a non-boss enemy
[*][b]Dark Spell: Darkening[/b] - A dark spell that summons 2 lightning bolts that damage enemies
[*][b]Ghostly Image[/b] - Whenever you dodge, summon a dark clone to attack nearby enemies
[*][b]Phantom Pulse[/b] - Whenever you dodge, summon a dark clone that deals AOE damage around it
[*][b]Grim Duality[/b] - Whenever you dodge, summon a dark clone that when defeated, casts a dark spell
[*][b]Void Field[/b] - Your dark spells have a 5% chance to instantly kill all non-boss enemies[/list]

[h3]Praxis Curses 🔥[/h3]
Wightsbury now includes a bunch of new cursed relics. Players will have the choice of selecting a temporary bane/boon combo. After clearing Wightsbury, the curse is lifted but the boon will remain for the rest of the run!
[list][*][b]Bane/Boon of Agility[/b] - Your move speed is reduced to half/You can quickly dodge twice
[*][b]Bane/Boon of Fortification[/b] - You can no longer dodge/Chain attacks destroy projectiles
[*][b]Bane/Boon of Leeching[/b] - You can no longer heal from items or healing rooms/Defeating an enemy heals you
[*][b]Bane/Boon of the Wights[/b] - All rooms are Wight rooms/Whenever you dodge an attack, haunt a random enemy
[*][b]Bane/Boon of the Deal[/b] - Randomly replaces your relics and skills. Repeats after defeating a boss or miniboss/Whenever you gain a relic, upgrade it if possible
[*][b]Bane/Boon of Shrouding[/b] - Except around you, darkness engulfs each room/You have a chance to ignore damage
[*][b]Bane/Boon of Mortality[/b] - Whenever you receive damage, you lose that much max HP/Whenever you defeat a boss or miniboss, increase your max HP
[*][b]Bane/Boon of Wisdom[/b] - Your second skill slot is locked/Your first skill slot gains additional charges
[/list]

[h3]Praxis Effects - New Difficulty Modifier[/h3]
In addition to the buffed effect, Praxis has expanded his power with new mid-run attacks. These random attacks can be turned on and customized via the Tyrant difficulty modifier.
[list][*][b]Suppression Obelisk[/b] - An obelisk appears that disables skills while active
[*][b]Celestial Impact[/b] - Deadly meteors rain down from above
[*][b]Plasma Barrage[/b] - Praxis claws appear and fire orbs
[*][b]Void Vortex[/b] - Black holes appear that pull and damage
[*][b]Dark Matter Beam[/b] - Praxis claws appear and fire lasers[/list]

[h3]Weapon Challenges, Skins, & Achievements[/h3]
For additional Knight customization, players will have 35 weapon skins that can be equipped. To unlock each skin, a unique and weapon-specific challenge must be completed.
Once each challenge is completed, an associated Steam achievement will be awarded.
[list][*][b]Ember Blade[/b][list][*][b]Amplified Ember Blade Challenge[/b] - Unlock all weapon mods for the Ember Blade

[*][b]Master Challenge[/b] - Complete a run without reviving with the Ember Blade

[h3]Final Praxis Fight[/h3]
To help make each fight more distinct, we've reworked a lot of the final Praxis fight. These changes should increase the difficulty but also make the fight much more unique and fun.
We also added a new music track for this fight!




[h2]Balancing & Minor Adjustments[/h2] 

In addition to the new content and features, we’ve also made the following changes and fixes.
[h3]Weapon Mod Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*][b]Ember Blade - Whirlwind[/b][list][*]Increased the damage
[*]Increased the pushback
[*]Increased the stun
[*]Increased the speed of the attack[/list]
[*][b]Ember Blade - Spin Attack[/b][list][*]Decreased the thrust distance
[*]Slightly decreased the thrust speed
[*]Increased the speed of the attack[/list]
[*][b]Guardian Bow - Perfectionist[/b][list][*]Increased the damage
[*]Increased the damage multiplier
[*]Added stun
[*]Decreased the pushback on the skillshot[/list]
[*][b]Guardian Bow - Invigorate[/b][list][*]Increased the attack rate[/list]
[*][b]Rift Hammer - Combat Slam[/b][list][*]Increased the damage multiplier
[*]Increased the distance of the leap[/list]
[*][b]Rift Hammer - Volcanic Rift[/b][list][*]Updated to deal increased damage on the first attack[/list]
[*][b]Rift Hammer - Overcharge[/b][list][*]Decreased the time to use 🔥[/list]
[*][b]Razor Wind - Hefty[/b][list][*]Increased the damage radius
[*]Increased the AOE damage
[*]Increased the stun value[/list]
[*][b]Reaper's Toll - Summoner[/b][list][*]Increased the ghost damage multiplier[/list]
[*][b]Reaper's Toll - Phantasm[/b][list][*]Increased the ghost damage multiplier[/list][/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list][*]Reworked Igna Za by enabling its rear to be vulnerable and reduced its travel distance, attack radius, and damage aura 🔥
[*]Reworked Glacial Bruma by reducing the number of ice waves, slowing the speed of the permafrost attack, and removed the ability for that attack to freeze players 🔥
[*]Reworked Overlord Mack by increasing the attack cooldowns for the bouncing projectile, charged spike, and energy blast attacks to help reduce the number of projectiles visible at any given time and removed the laser drones from spawning during its first phase and improved its attack indicators 🔥
[*]Swapped the order of the Mirror and Graveyard attacks during the third phase of the Poltergeist boss fight
[*]Updated boss drops from 2 small stat gems to 1 large stat gem and miniboss drops from 1 large stat gem to 2 small stat gems
[*]Increased the charge attack speed and added the ability to move while charging the Guardian Bow
[*]Increased the charge attack speed and increased the damage multiplier for the Rift Hammer
[*]Adjusted the tipper damage for the Razor Wind
[*]Updated Razor Wind's Empowered mod to function similar to Guardian Bow's Empowered Arrows mod
[*]Reduced the move speed and reduced the full heal when enemies become supercharged 🔥
[*]Updated Pristine Band, Flawless Brace, Absolute Ambition to reward each player when perfectly clearing a room 🔥
[*]Updated Bob's Containment Field functionality to include a cooldown 🔥
[*]Increased the lightning chance, growth, and max owned for Tainted Conduit 🔥
[*]Added an icon to the HUD for the Ember Tree upgrade Guardian Angel 🔥
[*]Updated Ember Tree upgrade Keen Eye to also trigger on miniboss deaths
[*]Updated Ember Tree upgrade Bonus Gems to drop a small stat gem for bosses and minibosses
[*]Updated Ember Tree upgrade Perfection to also include minibosses
[*]Updated Ember Tree upgrade Super Reroll to reset at the start of each world
[*]A bunch of improvements to various descriptions throughout the game[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] 
Last but not least, we fixed a bunch of issues.
[list][*]Fixed some issues that arise during endless looping 🔥
[i]We'd like to extend a really big thank you to our players who provided their time and feedback to help address this issue! ❤️[/i]
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug with the Relic Refinement drop that was causing 4-player local games to freeze after making the relic selections 🔥
[*]Fixed an issue with the Relic Refinement UI where one player scrolling the list of relics would cause the list to scroll for all players 🔥
[*]Fixed an issue where players were avoiding cutscenes while charging the Razor Wind
[*]Fixed an issue where players were avoiding cutscenes while equipped with the Ember Blade and holding the Flurry charge attack 🔥
[*]Fixed an issue with the Razor Wind's Burgeoning mod where it would not increase the projectile size when hitting an enemy if Empowered is also equipped 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the Rift Hammer's Unstable Rift mod that was allowing some bosses to become stunned 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Reaper's Toll where it was not performing multiple charge attacks in a row
[*]Fixed a minor issue with the Perfectionist charge attack
[*]Fixed a few issues related to the presentation of “New” relics 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Barrier Pendant where the player could still take damage 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Eye of the Storm where the previous projectile wasn't clearing properly
[*]Fixed an issue with Decayed Scepter where poison was only getting applied from perfectly casting pets
[*]Fixed a bug with the Arcane Orb where it wasn’t triggering Supreme Ambition
[*]Fixed a bug with Guardian Angel where it wasn't taking into account the player's armor 🔥
[*]Fixed a rare bug where Praxis could disappear during the fight if he picked an invalid teleport location at the end of some attacks
[*]Fixed an issue where Praxis minibosses return to their default state after being frozen
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the Wightsbury bosses where the Haunted Stakes could remain visible if killed while frozen
[*]Fixed an issue where some enemies would become invisible when frozen
[*]Fixed a few minor visual issues with the planets on the world loading screens
[*]A bunch of localization improvements 🔥[/list]

tags.feature: With the constant threat of Praxis rising, we felt it was necessary to add another weapon, inspired by the evil one himself.Harness the powers of Praxis with the all new [b]Void Mantle![/b]

Wightsbury just became more deadly...and more interesting? Here, you'll find curses - each bringing a new challenge to your plight, but don't fret, once the curse has been equipped, you'll also receive an immediate benefit. After the curse has been cleared, the unique benefit will persist for the rest of your run!

In addition to the Praxis-buffed enemies, we've added a bunch of new and deadly attacks that Praxis can do throughout your run to keep you on your toes. These random attacks add a noticeable increase to the difficulty so we've decided to add this feature as a new difficulty modifier. If you want this additional challenge, be sure to turn this modifier on and if not, no sweat!

Weapon customization is a feature we've had requested quite a bit and we loved the idea so much that we decided to add it!Complete a special weapon challenge to unlock a unique weapon skin and brand new Steam achievement!
The 7th weapon has arrived and it introduces a fun new way to continue the battle against Praxis!

Wightsbury now includes a bunch of new cursed relics. Players will have the choice of selecting a temporary bane/boon combo. After clearing Wightsbury, the curse is lifted but the boon will remain for the rest of the run!
In addition to the buffed effect, Praxis has expanded his power with new mid-run attacks. These random attacks can be turned on and customized via the Tyrant difficulty modifier.
For additional Knight customization, players will have 35 weapon skins that can be equipped. To unlock each skin, a unique and weapon-specific challenge must be completed.
Once each challenge is completed, an associated Steam achievement will be awarded.
To help make each fight more distinct, we've reworked a lot of the final Praxis fight. These changes should increase the difficulty but also make the fight much more unique and fun.
We also added a new music track for this fight!

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

As big of an update as Knights Reforged is, we had a surprisingly small amount of issues. However, there were some and thanks to your help, we identified and fixed a handful. Please take a look at the issues we fixed in this hotfix patch!

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback[/i]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted various Ember Tree upgrade costs
[*]Updated a few enemy values for endless looping
[list][*]Loop 1
[list][*]Enemy Health - 400% (was 200%)[/list][*]Loop 2[list][*]Enemy Health - 800% (was 400%)[/list][*]Loops 3+[list][*]Enemy Health - continues to double on every loop[*]Enemy Damage - continues to double on every loop[/list][/list][*]Note: No change to scaling on enemy attack speed, move speed, or spawning[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with the Ember Blade where attacks couldn't be canceled by rolling 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Doppleganger’s seeking projectiles that prevented them from spawning 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Cleanup Crew that was causing voltage traps to be destroyed when one of the minibosses is defeated 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Praxis where he could dash or teleport out of bounds 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the revive prompt wasn’t clearing after being revived by defeating a miniboss or boss 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Super Rerolls where it was causing the game to lock when used in the Relic Refinement selectors and shops 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Absolute Ambition where it was multiplying its skill damage increase 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Steward’s Gift where it wasn’t spawning the Steward properly
[*]Fixed a bug with the Ember Tree’s Bonus Gems upgrade where it was showing the wrong icon when locked
[*]Fixed some visual issues with overlapping elements in the Ember Tree
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing costs from showing in the swap menu of the Ember Tree
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the Perfect Room and Perfect Boss banners to stop animating when the game is paused or the player inventory is viewed 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where Perfect Rooms and Perfect Bosses were desyncing between the host and clients
[*]Fixed some minor localization issues 🔥[/list]

[h3]Fixed on November 28th - b4024[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where players were unable to revive in online multiplayer games 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Overlord Mack where he was getting stuck and locking players from progressing 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where Guardian Bow’s Perfectionist charge attack was registering as a third attack 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing duplicate projectiles from Eye of the Storm being destroyed 🔥[/list]

That's it for now. Thank you for your continued support!
-Doom Turtle

notes.title: Knights Reforged Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/2063063ee2c6d7c082fb3516335d6a695ea493c3.jpg[/img]

Hello Knights!

We're back with [b]Update 1.2 - Knights Reforged![/b] This massive update is easily in the top 2 or 3 for biggest updates ever! Take a look below for what this huge update includes! 
[b]Also, be sure to check out the very bottom of the patch notes to see the exciting news for 2024![/b]


[h1]Weapon Mods[/h1]
We wanted this update to be focused on strengthening existing systems to better fit our design intentions and we started with Weapon Mods. This huge overhaul involves replacing 28 mods with brand new ones, improving a bunch of existing mods, and adding new Ultimate Mods!

[h3]Ember Blade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/fa5e24114189f66a4383172a4d558a62f893d561.png[/img]We introduced some new mods to help provide broader access to early synergies and we also gave the Ember Blade a new charge attack.

[h3]Guardian Bow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/66b55afc8f54d37ade0d0f4813af52e056c11dd4.png[/img]Through community feedback and data analysis, we learned that the charge attack wasn't getting used as often as we had intended. To help make charging the Guardian Bow more viable, we improved its functionality as well as introduce some new mods to help promote the playstyle.

[h3]Nexal Staff[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/8bde789f7e95823efcb1895f2c7d4775944c8a97.png[/img]The Nexal Staff received some of the biggest changes. While we felt like it was already performing quite well, we also felt like the mods could be doing more to play into the "skill use" aspect of the weapon. To achieve this, we added mods that help increase skill damage as well as scale the Orbs damage based on your skill damage %.

[h3]Rift Hammer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/6e54f7aa677702c50b0552842b765e31f65c22be.png[/img]With the Rift Hammer, we wanted to make improvements to help promote damage and survivability and we did that by introducing mods, Heavy Blow and Defensive Stance.
We improved Leap which can be found under its new name, Combat Slam. Now, you'll be able to control the length and landing position of the leap.
We also added Volcanic Rift, similar to its predecessor Fissure but now with a larger range and fiery AOE.

[h3]Razor Wind[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/f7f687a38d9abb1bce57f2da388ab5317cbba63c.png[/img]Through community feedback, we learned that a lot of the original mods, while unique, were not as useful as we had intended. For the Razor Wind changes, we decided to move away from manipulation and focus more on how players were already using it with increased functionality for normal and charged attacks.

[h3]Reaper's Toll[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/1aca00bd1d070558ec1e8ebfdacd40944cd1091a.png[/img]The largest of the mod overhauls, many of the original mods for Reaper's Toll leaned towards isolated effects rather than synergizing with other effects. 
We've now focused on the charge attack, ammo, and "Slashed" status to refine the weapon's identity.

[h3]Ultimate Mods[/h3]
We've also added a new Ultimate Mod for each weapon which becomes available when all other mods for that weapon are unlocked. This is a free mod that can be activated without needing to choose between other mods. Give them a try and let us know what you think!


[h1]Ember Tree[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/3c095af007528151d8ed3dcfc57e5033c0347958.png[/img]It was also time to improve the Ember Tree and for that, we updated almost every upgrade option as well as add a bunch of new and interesting choices!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/cea37e0201f946872a604e47384a834ac22238d1.png[/img]Also, check out the brand new completion sequence!



[h1]New Relics[/h1]
Next, we looked at the pool of relics to see how we could push stronger build synergies, especially with Wisps. We also introduced the concept of Perfect Rooms and Perfect Bosses; rooms cleared without taking any damage.
To this end, we added a bunch of new relics including the DEMONS Mode Community Contest Relic which was designed in collaboration with [b]Tfeh[/b] for being the one and only person to complete the DEMONS challenge. A huge congratulations to him for an absolutely epic run!


[h1]So much more![/h1]
This is a massive update so keep reading for the full list of additions and improvements but before you scroll down to see the complete list, please consider voting for us in the upcoming Steam Awards! We'd be extremely honored to receive your vote for the [b]Better with Friends[/b] award.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/d709c70ec0eb0e687396f6dbc73a9688e8f9ed4e.png[/img][/url]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Weapon Mods[/h3]
[list][*]Overhauled the entire mod system 🔥
[*]Added a new Ultimate Mod for each weapon 🔥
[list][*][b]Ember Blade[/b]
[list][*]Honed - No change
[*]Spark - No change
[*][b]Stagger (NEW)[/b] - Your first weapon hit on an enemy has a chance to stun
[*][b]Flurry (NEW)[/b] - Gain a charge attack where you unleash a flurry of rapid attacks
[*]Whirlwind - No change
[*]Lunge - No change
[*]Momentum - No change
[*][b]Smite (NEW)[/b] - Whenever you stun an enemy, your next attack will unleash a lightning bolt
[*][b]Pyrostrike (NEW)[/b] - Whenever you crit an enemy, you also burn that enemy[*][b]Spin Attack [Ultimate] (NEW)[/b] - Your 3rd attack is a spin attack[/list][*][b]Guardian Bow[/b]
[list][*]Rapid Shot - No change
[*]Spread Shot - No change
[*][b]Opportunist (NEW)[/b] - Your charge attack deals bonus damage to enemies afflicted by status ailments
[*][b]Ricochet (NEW)[/b] - Your charge attacks will ricochet to additional enemies
[*]Volley - No change
[*][b]Perfectionist (NEW)[/b] - Chaining perfect charge attacks adds additional arrows
[*]Marked Shot - No change
[*]Explosive Arrows - No change
[*][b]Invigorate (NEW)[/b] - Whenever you defeat an enemy, increase your attack speed[*][b]Empowered Arrows [Ultimate] (NEW)[/b]- Perfect weapon attacks empower your next chain attacks[/list][*][b]Nexal Staff[/b]
[list][*]Luminescence - No change

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

A big thanks to everyone for their help identifying and troubleshooting a bunch of these bugs! Please see below for everything that's included in this hotfix update.

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback[/i]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Updated Ignition Break to be able to cook food
[*]Updated the Ember Shrine to update the Knight when navigating the presets
[*]Added a spooky surprise[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was causing a black screen to persist when returning to the main menu from the pause menu 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was happening in local multiplayer where teams couldn’t enter Wightsbury 🔥
[*]Fixed some issues with Reaper’s Toll hitbox 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Razor Wind that was preventing the charge attack from being buffered after two regular chain attacks are performed 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing The Forlorn Champion decoys to display their laser indicators 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with The Forlorn Champion that was causing it to become invisible when frozen during one of its attacks 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the Mimic King room that was causing multiple music tracks to play when hitting the record player to wake up the Mimic King 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with Nexal Staff’s Wisdom mod that was causing skill drops to display incorrect hits to refresh values 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing players to appear white after reviving if they died and recharged a skill at the same time 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was not matching the VFX with the effect radius for Bruma’s Ring
[*]Fixed some issues with the Ember Tree UI that was preventing players from navigating without closing and reopening the Tree
[*]Fixed a softlock issue in Netherra shops 🔥
[*]Reduced the volume on the intro logos[/list]


Also, some really cool news since 1.1!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/5fde1a1f9ae6092ddfd8448f2d73582e8217e45a.png[/img]

That's it for now...next stop, 1.2!
-Doom Turtle

notes.title: Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

Did you think 1.0 was the end for Ember Knights? Not even close! 

We've been collecting all the comments, suggestions, and feedback from 1.0, married those with our vision, and have put together a BIG list of improvements for our first postlaunch update!

[h1]Netherra[/h1]
The Praxis Realm received a major update! 
To make decisions meaningful, we've added rewards everywhere including a new reward type for completing all 8 portals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/1f0aa5f99ab599cef4673dfd5ff784b57a675cd8.png[/img]
We've also added 2 new Praxis-inspired skills that should bring out a little evil sorcerer in everyone!
In addition, we've also added a bunch of new rooms and made some important enemy and hazard balancing changes.

[h1]Easy Mode[/h1]
This has been a popular request from our players. Some find the game too difficult, some find the game too easy, and some find a big skill disparity between teammates. We're hopeful that these new options make the game more accessible for more players.

[h1]Ember Shrine[/h1]
Another popular request has been Knight customization. We've revived an asset we made long before the Combat Demo days and repurposed it for the brand new Ember Shrine. Replacing the Ember Pit, the Shrine will allow much more customization with the current player colors. It will also allow us to add further customizations so keep an eye out for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/2ee40846ac67b1a5572fdf17cc07af5da9b30e66.png[/img]

[h1]Nexus Improvements[/h1]
We've made a bunch of visual improvements to the Nexus. Check out the Weapons area, Skills area, and Compendium to see all that's been done!

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
Listening to all the 1.0 feedback, we prepared and tackled a massive list of improvements that touch almost every component of the game!

Keep reading for the full list of additions, improvements, and fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2] 
[h3]Netherra 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Added rewards to each room as well as added a special reward for completing all 8 portals
[*]Added new rooms including Healing Rooms, Offering Pits, Miniboss Rooms, Selector Rooms, Shops, and more
[*]Adjusted the requirement on the second hub from 2 portals to 3
[*]Balancing changes to the enemies and hazards[/list]
[h3]Netherra Skills[/h3]
[list][*]Soul Siphon - Details: [spoiler]Conjure a Praxis-like laser that blasts enemies in its path and gain bonus skill damage on each enemy for interesting skill combinations[/spoiler]
[*]Gravity Well - Details: [spoiler]Cast a giant black hole that will pull and slow enemies as well as deal AOE damage[/spoiler][/list]
[h3]Easy Mode 🔥[/h3]
On each new save slot, you'll be able to choose an Easy, Normal, or Hard experience.

[h3]Ember Shrine 🔥[/h3]
With the new Ember Shrine, you'll be able to choose your flame and armor independently of each other.

[h3]Nexus Improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Weapons Area - Visual improvements to better indicate Mod completion
[*]Skills Area - Visual improvements to better indicate Skill collection
[*]Compendium Area - Visual improvements to add a little more life to the area[/list]


[h2]Balancing[/h2] 

In addition to the new content and features, we’ve also made the following changes:
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[list][*]Ember Fire 🔥
[list][*]Reduced hits to refresh from 10 to 8
[*]Increased max charges from 1 to 2
[*]Increased damage from 15/20/25 to 20/25/35[/list][*]Frost Wall
[list][*]Increased damage from 15/20/25 to 20/25/30[/list][*]Phantom Spear 🔥
[list][*]Increased damage from 15/15/20 to 20/25/30
[*]Adjusted poison stacks from 3/3/5 to 2/3/4[/list][*]Rupture
[list][*]Decreased damage from 30/30/30 to 20/25/30
[*]Increased hits to refresh from 12 to 15[/list][*]Chakram
[list][*]Reduced max charges from 2 to 1
[*]Reduced bounces on Perfect by 1
[*]Adjusted damage from 12/14/16 to 15/15/15[/list][*]Cyclone
[list][*]Adjusted damage from 3/5/8 to 4/5/6[/list][*]Ballista
[list][*]Adjusted attack rate from 0.8/0.5/0.3 to 0.5/0.4/0.3 (in seconds)[/list][*]Judgment 🔥
[list][*]Adjusted damage from 15/15/20 to 50/35/30
[*]Reduced cast delay from 0.45/0.45/0.45 to 0.25/0.2/0.15[/list][*]Adjusted all Skills to have a 0.15s Perfect cast window 🔥
[*]Adjusted minimum hits to refresh to never go below 5[/list]
[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list][*]Rejuvenation Glove 🔥
[list][*]Adjusted rarity from Epic to Common
[*]Increased max owned from 1 to 3[/list][*]Ripe Elderberry 🔥
[list][*]Adjusted rarity from Common to Epic
[*]Reduced max owned to 1[/list][*]Chronograph
[list][*]Adjusted max owned to 4 with growth of 1[/list][*]Giant Mace
[list][*]Adjusted rarity from Epic to Common[/list][*]Stun Powder 🔥
[list][*]Adjusted rarity from Common to Epic[/list][*]Combustion Stone
[list][*]Adjusted growth to 10[/list][*]Conduit Spike
[list][*]Increased damage from 2-8 to 4-10
[*]Adjusted growth to 1-10
[*]Improved visuals to match VFX from lightning Staff[/list][*]Steel Greaves
[list][*]Adjusted rarity from Epic to Common
[*]Reduced Armor from 5 to 2[/list][*]Empowered Bangle
[list][*]Reduced damage from 75% to 50%
[*]Adjusted max owned to 2[/list][*]Supreme Ambition 🔥
[list][*]Updated description to reflect permanent increase on Skill damage[/list][*]Titan's Wargear 🔥
[list][*]Updated description to reflect permanent increase on Weapon damage[/list][*]Magic Tome 🔥
[list][*]Adjusted description to better convey where damage comes from[/list][*]Bruma's Ring
[list][*]Updated visuals and sounds[/list][*]Adjusted gold cost on various Relics[/list]
[h3]Endgame Modifiers[/h3]
[list][*]Added the DEMONS difficulty tier 🔥
[*]Added buttons to activate and deactivate all modifiers 🔥
[*]Adjusted values so harder modifiers are worth more 🔥
[*]Added more ranks to Aficionado (8, 6, and 4 max relics)
[*]Visual improvements[/list]
[h3]Endless Looping 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]In addition to adjusting enemy damage and enemy health, added enemy attack speed, enemy move speed, and enemy spawning
[*]Loop 1
[list][*]Enemy Health - 200%
[*]Enemy Damage - 200%
[*]Enemy Attack Speed - 135%
[*]Enemy Move Speed - 175%
[*]Enemy Spawning - 175%[/list][*]Loop 2
[list][*]Enemy Health - 400%
[*]Enemy Damage - 400%
[*]Enemy Attack Speed - 200%
[*]Enemy Move Speed - 300%
[*]Enemy Spawning - 300%[/list][*]Loops 3+
[list][*]Enemy Health - exponential growth
[*]Enemy Damage - exponential growth
[*]Enemy Attack Speed - no longer increases
[*]Enemy Move Speed - no longer increases
[*]Enemy Spawning - no longer increases[/list][/list]
[list][*]Added a borderless window mode 🔥
[*]Healing rooms now also fully charge skills
[*]Updated shop rerolling so a reroll can present a new type of item 🔥
[*]Added Ember to secret rooms for subsequent entries after the Ember dust has been collected 🔥
[*]Added stat gems to miniboss rewards 🔥
[*]Adjusted the intro and outro animations on Scoggfirth and Wightsbury bosses
[*]Added damage reduction on phase transitions for Scoggfirth and Wightsbury bosses
[*]Changed the Apple Crisp to give a full charge to the first skill
[*]Updated the player indicators to match the player color 🔥
[*]Added Ash to the top left of the inventory/status screens 🔥
[*]Visual and layout adjustments to player inventories
[*]Added VFX for when a skill is ready 🔥

[*]Added a low HP animation to the player HUD
[*]Moved buttons tips closer to the player
[*]Updated the visuals for the player revive sequence
[*]Hid the HP bar during revive animations

[*]Minor Ember Tree improvements including a visual to indicate when a node is not ready but can be unlocked and player feedback for players 2-4 when trying to interact with the Ember Tree in local co-op 
[*]Decreased the time it takes for the Room Complete banner to clear 🔥
[*]Changed the relic selector so the window pops-up instantly after interacting with it similar to skill selector
[*]Updated lightning VFX on relics to reduce visual noise 🔥
[*]Changed FTUE rewards from a random skill and relic to a skill selector and relic selector
[*]Adjusted the visual indicator to the Snow Witch’s attack
[*]Visual changes to Bruma’s ring VFX
[*]Added SFX to Bruma’s ring
[*]Added shake to the ice pillars in Steadfast Citadel
[*]Added SFX for chained status effect when player tries to move in Steadfast Citadel
[*]Added a charge attack indicator to The Forlorn’s laser attack 🔥
[*]Wisps are killed after they light the door to the secret room in Wightsbury
[*]Adjusted the position of Evee’s Care Package in Wightsbury 🔥
[*]Big visual pass on Anville to help with visual noise and clarity 🔥
[*]Updated spawn VFX for all enemies
[*]A bunch of improvements to the Mimic King
[*]Increased damage reduction on Praxis buffed enemies from 0.75 to 0.95
[*]Removed the crossed swords doormats 🔥[/list]


[h1]Bugs [/h1]

And finally, the massive list of bug fixes!
[list][*]Fixed a few bugs where projectiles were behaving inconsistently. This includes fixing the issue with Arlan's Lucky Dice projectile staying on screen if spawned beside a pit or wall 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where the armor icon was showing its previous state
[*]Fixed a bug where Pilot Light wasn't cooking dropped items 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug where Bitter Chisel wasn't healing the player when killing a frozen enemy
[*]Fixed a few issues where upgrades on armor relics were not triggering armor-based events. This includes Steel Greaves, Guard Scepter, Wizard's Fleece, and Spite Shield 🔥

[*]Fixed a few issues that were causing the wrong currency to show in the Nexus shop

[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Lord Bruma to face the wrong direction during his charge attacks
[*]Fixed some issues with Glacial Bruma’s wind attack so the wind doesn’t persistent into subsequent phases 🔥

[*]Fixed a bug with Herald that was preventing the chain attack from dealing damage to the player
[*]Fixed a bug with Beguile's ring attack projectiles where they wouldn't return to the origin of casting for clients in multiplayer games
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with the Phantom variants' intro sequences
[*]Fixed a few issues that were preventing volt traps from deactivating properly
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with the Anville boss variants' animations
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing gold that can't be collected to appear after beating Praxis 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with enemy projectiles that was preventing them from fading their shadows when the enemy dies
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing enemies to target invisible players when walking into a new room 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the victory music from playing after defeating Skrixxa Za for the first time 🔥
[*]Fixed a few bugs that would arise from enemies breaking props
[*]Fixed an online multiplayer bug where the Ultimate weapon skin wasn't being applied properly after dying and restarting 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

As usual, if you want to stay on top of the news, see new content before it's live, share your favourite memes, or simply chat strategy about the best weapons and skills, join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions during the Early Access and beyond, so be sure to join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=discord.gg%2Femberknights&snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!

notes.title: Nexus News - 1.0 and Beyond!
notes.content:
Greetings, Knights!


We did it! After 25 updates and patches throughout Early Access, we made it to 1.0!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/1cbbbddda5d415f1afedf8a185d8e510db973cf8.jpg[/img]

It’s been an incredible experience to see where we started and how far we’ve come and seeing our vision become a reality has been truly rewarding. Throughout this journey, we’ve been blessed to receive tons of positive feedback and support and we’re very appreciative for all the comments and suggestions to help improve the game. Ember Knights would not be what it is today without you, our amazing players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/d9d83123de406c6500e8a74dfd41bd6d1860cec6.png[/img]

Now, if you joined us during our Early Access, you’ll know that working with the community is what we do. If you’re new to Ember Knights, trust us when we say, just because we’ve reached 1.0, it doesn’t mean we’re done with Ember Knights – not by a long shot!

On that note, let’s take a peek at what’s coming in our 1.1 update, available the week of September 18th.


[h2]Update 1.1[/h2]
We’re in the final stages of wrapping up everything for our first scheduled postlaunch update. We wanted to take our time with this one to make sure we heard from as many of you as we could. Well, we’ve listened and we believe we’ve put together a really great update for you! Without spoiling too much, we’ve put together some highlights below.

[h3]Netherra[/h3]
The Praxis realm is getting a big and much needed overhaul and that includes the following:
[list][*]Rewards! They’re now all over the place and decisions matter!
[*]New room types including Healing Rooms, Offering Pits, Miniboss Rooms, and more
[*]Enemy balancing and area hazard adjustments[/list]
[h3]More Difficulty Options[/h3]
To help a wider range of players, we’ve added another layer of difficulty options. On each save slot, you’ll have the option of selecting Easy, Normal, or Hard to better suit your experience and mood.

[h3]Ember Shrine[/h3]
To add more customization to your Knight, we’ve brought back an asset we made a long time ago, even before our Combat Demo, added a bunch of improvements and polish, and made it our brand new, Ember Shrine. So long Ember Pit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/89029b7addaf41148a61d47449dd9478abee9cc5.png[/img]

With the Ember Shrine, you’ll be able to choose your flame color and outfit independently of each other, so instead of 14 color combinations, you’ll now have 196! Keep an eye on the Shrine for more customization options down the road…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/2ee40846ac67b1a5572fdf17cc07af5da9b30e66.png[/img]

[h3]Nexus Improvements[/h3]
One of the first things you’ll notice is a bit of a new look for the Nexus. We’ve reworked the Weapon and Skill areas and gave the Compendium a little bit of love. You may even see a Steward catching up on some light reading.

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
We’ve made a HUGE number of QoL improvements which cover Skills, Relics, Endgame Modifiers, Endless Looping, Healing Rooms, Mimic King, Anville, and so much more!

As always, when 1.1 drops, we’ll include the complete patch notes and be prepared, it’s a big one!


[h2]Nintendo Switch[/h2]

As well as putting together the 1.1 update, we’ve also prepared a pretty significant patch for the Switch. We’ve received word from Nintendo that it’s been approved and scheduled to release today, September 12th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/3ae59cd69ef4af2fc71395fac0363ed073b635ef.png[/img]

This patch will include a bunch of optimizations specifically for the Switch as well as all the content and fixes currently available on PC.

We’re still figuring out the best way to keep the Switch version as current as the PC version and we’ll be putting out updates for both, as close to each other as we can, but given the differences in submission processes, we expect the Switch updates to lag slightly behind the PC updates.

Thank you for the questions regarding online multiplayer but we don’t have an update on this at the moment.


[h2]So, what’s next?[/h2]
In addition to preparing the 1.1 and Switch updates, we’ve also been busy putting our thoughts together for new content and features for the future. It’s still way too early to share any big news but looking ahead at 1.2, we’re starting to work on the following:
[list][*]Wightsbury balancing
[*]Anville balancing
[*]Ember Tree updating
[*]Weapon & Mod updating
[*]New relics[/list]
Some really exciting things are in the works but we can’t spoil any of that quite yet!


[h2]Community[/h2]
An edition of Nexus News wouldn’t be complete without highlighting some of our amazing community members!

[h3]DEMONS[/h3]
Firstly, we have to again acknowledge our Discord member, Tfeh for his amazing accomplishment of being the first and only person to finish the DEMONS challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/d3d7264b29ef26f70e209d7e3ec05f83a98bac73.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t yet seen the run, you can check it out here: [previewyoutube=6MgzF5B_-yg;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6MgzF5B_-yg[/previewyoutube]
As promised, he now gets to work with us to design a new relic! We worked together on one already but unfortunately, it didn’t play nice with our existing systems so we’re back to the drawing board. We’re planning to include this joint collaboration in our 1.2 update.

If you’re up for an incredibly difficult challenge, definitely give DEMONS a try. After all, Tfeh is likely lonely being the only person to hold the special Discord role, DEMONS CHAMPION.


[h3]Speedrunning[/h3]
Speaking of challenges and records, check out this incredible speedrun from Discord member, QuirkyTurtle!

[previewyoutube=xHzkHx2fzKw;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xHzkHx2fzKw[/previewyoutube]
This sub 7 minute run is currently the world record! Amazing stuff!

If you're interested in speedrunning Ember Knights, check out the official leaderboard here: [url=https://www.speedrun.com/ember_knights]https://www.speedrun.com/ember_knights[/url]


[h3]Wiki[/h3]
If you're looking for more information on Ember Knights, check out the player-made Wiki here: [url=https://ember-knights-game.fandom.com/wiki/Ember_Knights_-_Game_Wiki]https://ember-knights-game.fandom.com/wiki/Ember_Knights_-_Game_Wiki[/url]

A huge thanks to zza675, Sky, Kif, Diamondara, and all other contributors!


[h3]Fanart[/h3]
Don’t worry if making videos isn’t your thing. We also love to share incredible artwork that we receive. Check out some awesome pieces below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/a2e62e2d1b378141e2e83a045576a11d1ef82f58.png[/img][i]Arlan in deep thought, likely anticipating our upcoming dev stream where we talk Ember Knights trivia. Made by Discord member, Lost[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/9329ec15a63f7143c21b41fa0e05cc5bbaabd8e9.jpg[/img][i]An incredible model of a Steward admiring a Nexus flower. Made by Discord member, Bullseye Buttonmasher[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/dd53953c33aefb8215f080207ee01de0565a5e60.png[/img][i]Esper has a daughter!? From Discord member, Витëк[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/1f5d54b871fbad700c91bb111a0046ac2f42494d.jpg[/img][i]A meditating Knight by Discord member, Rush[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/a4f39a1b0cf19b91ef1339fbe0070ad59068e5f9.jpg[/img][i]Praxis never looked so evil. Check out this piece by Discord member, Rai[/i]

[h3]Videos[/h3]
With the drop of 1.0, we’ve also been fortunate to see so many exciting gameplay videos and streams. Check out a small sample of some of our favorites below!

[previewyoutube=MpZe_scOji4;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=H2aAEaq1msQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=1PfhHFilq_I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Discord[/h3]
If you haven’t yet joined our Discord server, we’d love to have you. We’re now over 5,800 members and growing every day!

[url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]https://discord.gg/emberknights[/url]

It’s an incredible resource for game information, tips, multiplayer matchmaking, and more. We’ve said it before and we’ll say it again – without a doubt, we have one of the best and most welcoming gaming communities around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/bce90304ff4cc6e8f2288dcb4db745783388ffaa.png[/img]

[h3]Reviews[/h3]
We'd like to take the time to acknowledge and sincerely thank everyone for taking the time to leave a positive review. We're closing in on 3,000 and for small studios like us, they're incredibly important. So, from all of us at Doom Turtle, thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/18f6d9ae8ace6a4ac494eeff0b54e86fdf8b41d8.png[/img]

See you next week for the release of 1.1!

tags.feature: To help a wider range of players, we’ve added another layer of difficulty options.
On each save slot, you’ll have the option of selecting Easy, Normal, or Hard to better suit your experience and mood.

To add more customization to your Knight, we’ve brought back an asset we made a long time ago, even before our Combat Demo, added a bunch of improvements and polish, and made it our brand new, Ember Shrine.
With the Ember Shrine, you’ll be able to choose your flame color and outfit independently of each other, so instead of 14 color combinations, you’ll now have 196!
One of the first things you’ll notice is a bit of a new look for the Nexus.
We’ve reworked the Weapon and Skill areas and gave the Compendium a little bit of love.
This patch will include a bunch of optimizations specifically for the Switch as well as all the content and fixes currently available on PC.

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, Knights!

We're close to wrapping up everything for our 1.1 update but we wanted to get some of these fixes out before then, so we've prepared the following hotfix patch. Please see below for everything that's included.

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback[/i]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was causing the player to get stuck behind the door when reviving in the True Praxis boss room 🔥
[*]Fixed a few bugs that were preventing clients from entering the tear to the Architect's Realm when the host is dead 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Arbiters to spawn Grimlins out of bounds occasionally getting stuck and softlocking the player 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Praxis to escape the boss room via his Killer Grasp attack
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the Champion Gar-Ghoul to occasionally travel and get stuck out of bounds 🔥
[*]Fixed a few bugs that were preventing players from rejoining games via Steam invite 🔥
[*]Fixed a multiplayer issue where disconnected players could prevent the viewing of other players' inventories 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual desync issue that was causing clients to see more health than they have when a miniboss or boss is killed and they have the Earned Vitality Ember Tree upgrade active 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with the Rotworm's spawn animation when spawned from the Champion Rotworm
[*]Fixed a few visual issues with miniboss and boss health bars[/list]

We'd like to send out a really big thank you to our community for helping us identify and troubleshoot most of these issues!

That's it for now...see you all in a few weeks for the 1.1 update!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions during the Early Access and beyond, so be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/609473260832423967/609473261314637854]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello all,

With every update, there's bound to be a few issues. Thanks to our amazing community, we've identified and fixed a bunch of bugs as well as make a few minor balancing adjustments. Please see below!

[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback[/i]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
Reaper's Toll Adjustments 🔥[list][*]Updated the hitbox for 1st and 2nd attacks to cover a small gap near the player
[*]Adjusted the timing of the attack sequence to be slightly more forgiving[/list]Updated the revive label for dead players while in Netherra

Updated the Discord Rich Presence to handle new Discord names


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug in local multiplayer where players couldn't exit the boss room in Anville 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug in local multiplayer where players couldn't exit the start room in the Architect realm 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was showing dead players when traveling through the tear to the Architect realm 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug in local multiplayer where newly unlocked weapons couldn't be equipped by players 2-4 🔥
[*]Fixed a desync issue with displaying the available ammo on Reaper's Toll
[*]Fixed an issue with Reaper's Toll where pulling enemies at the end of their teleportation would cause the game to loop through and instantly clear rooms 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Steam achievements from being unlocked if their associated challenges were completed in the first hour after launch 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing players to get stuck between doors when traveling to and from the secret rooms 🔥
[*]Fixed a few bugs that were preventing players from reviving in Netherra
[*]Fixed a bug where players who closed the game and then reconnected couldn't see the button tip for manually reviving
[*]Fixed a bug with Cyclone that was causing instances of it getting stuck on walls immediately after casting when next to a wall 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the teleportation of dead players causing various issues 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues related to displaying status effects when stacking multiple status effects of the same type
[*]Fixed an encoding issue with the main menu background that was causing black screens 🔥
[*]Fixed a few visual issues related to the tilemap in some rooms[/list]

As always, a big thanks to you for helping us with these issues!

That's it for now. See you at 1.1!

notes.title: Ember Knights 1.0 - AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, Knights!

This is it! After countless hours of hard work, passion and creativity, [b]Ember Knights 1.0 is now available[/b] for everyone to play, and we couldn't be more excited! This full release is filled with exciting new content and the continuation of the story you've all been waiting for! We've poured our hearts into crafting this colorful adventure and we can't wait for you to experience it with us. So we hope you enjoy the journey, the thrill of discovery, the joy of cooperation, and the satisfaction of overcoming seemingly insurmountable challenges!

[previewyoutube=C7gA4CzUk0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Confront the ultimate challenge[/h1]

With the full release, you will finally get to invade Praxis' lair, where untold dangers await. The new area looks like nothing you have seen before and you will need to be on top of your game to make it through it unscathed! Brace yourself for an intense battle with fearsome new monsters and their merciless master, the ultimate test of your skills.

Be prepared for an adventure that goes beyond the conventional final boss encounter. And once you think you've conquered and triumphed, is it truly the end? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/49d727fec41caf82c2ed58a0af6d5f54c80a07db.png[/img]

[h1]Master a new weapon[/h1]

To help you in your quest, we are introducing an awe-inspiring [b]new weapon — Reaper's Toll[/b]. With its razor-sharp blade and elegant yet deadly moves, this scythe combines swift strikes and wide-reaching arcs of devastation! Reaper's Toll joins an already well-furnished arsenal of weapons that each define the way you engage in combat. 

[h1]Enjoy a 15% launch discount[/h1]

You can buy Ember Knights at a discounted price until [b]July 25[/b]. A perfect opportunity for your friends to tag along! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135230/Ember_Knights/

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to our incredible community that has supported us throughout this journey through the Early Access (and now beyond!). Your feedback, dedication, and enthusiasm have been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today. With your help, we have achieved an overwhelmingly positive status on Steam and we couldn't be more humbled. 

[h1]Join our vibrant community![/h1]

Stay tuned for more updates and exclusive content by following us on our official channels. We can't wait to continue this unforgettable journey with you! 

You can find us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url].
And finally, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!


[i]See you soon, Knights![/i]

notes.title: Ember Knights 1.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

The full version is finally here! If you haven't yet seen the announcement post, check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1135230/view/3665415870861658595]here[/url].

Now, onto what's included with 1.0! As always, items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback.


[h1]New Content and Features[/h1] 

[h3]New Area - Netherra (The Tyrant's Realm)[/h3]
The fifth and final area

[h3]Praxis Fight[/h3]
The long-awaited battle against Praxis

[h3]New Weapon - Reaper's Toll[/h3]
The sixth weapon, a large slicing blade used to rush down enemies or slash at them from afar

[h3]New Difficulty Modifier System[/h3]
A vastly expanded difficulty system to customize your experience and offer new challenges for players of all skills

[h3]Endless Looping 🔥[/h3]
An infinite running experience for those looking to crank their stats to ridiculous levels
The most requested feature throughout all of Early Access!

[h3]Boss Variants[/h3]
Each boss now has two new variants to test your mettle

[h3]Challenges[/h3]
A new system for the all new in-game challenges. This list also expands the Steam Achievement list

[h3]Wightsbury Champ[/h3]
A formidable champion version of The Forlorn

[h3]Anville Champ[/h3]
A deadly champion version of the Cleaver

[h3]New player colors 🔥[/h3]
A handful of new colors, each with their own unlock condition

[h3]New Battle Rooms[/h3]
Each world has at least 10 new battle rooms

[h3]Replaying Cinematics[/h3]
From the Main Menu, you'll be able to replay all unlocked cinematics


[h1]Balancing[/h1] 

[h3]Wightsbury Enemy Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]The Forlorn - reduced HP
[*]Condemned - slightly reduced HP. Removed the increased damage multiplier when they're stuck in the ground. Added the dagger throw attack to the elite version
[*]Weald Wolf - reduced HP[/list]
[h3]Anville Enemy Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Overlord Mack - increased movement speed. Increased attack rate in all phases
[*]Welder - large increase to HP. Re-enabled direction changing during its attack
[*]Cleaver - increase to HP
[*]Defense Bot - slight increase to HP
[*]Hypercharger - large increase to HP. Adjusted the attack indicators
[*]Shocker - large increase to HP. Slight reduction to the bolt damage delay
[*]Cleaver - reduction to the scissor attack hold time[/list]
[h3]Freeze Status Effect 🔥[/h3]
[list][*]Added max duration of multiple freezes to 5s
[*]Added frozen enemies receive increased damage
[*]Reduced the frozen duration when damaging a frozen enemy
[*]Reduced the frozen movement slow for bosses from 20% to 10%
[*]Reduced the frozen attack rate slow for bosses from 15% to 10%[/list]
[h3]Healing[/h3]
[list][*]Removed the white flash from the Healing Rooms
[*]Reduced the overall healing in Wightsbury
[*]Adjusted the visuals on the small healing prop in Wightsbury
[*]Replaced the three apples in the room before the Anville boss with chicken[/list]
[h3]Knight's Charge Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Increased the refresh count from 10 to 12
[*]Reduced charges from 2 to 1
[*]Adjusted the damage from 5/10/15 to 10/12/15[/list]
[h3]Relic Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Storm Ward - Added a % chance to trigger stun 🔥
[*]Stun Powder - Reduced bonus stun to 50% 🔥
[*]Infernal Scale - Increased bonus damage. Removed damage bonus to Ember Fire
[*]Ignition Break - Increased duration. Faster tick rate
[*]Glacier Necklace - Added projectile that can hit a maximum of two enemies 🔥[/list]
Increased the minimum charge time on the Rift Hammer 🔥

Slightly reduced the values for Ember Tree upgrades related to boss and non boss damage

Increased the number of Praxis buffed enemy encounters

Increased the occurrence of miniboss variants

Removed the flinch behavior from the Rakknid

Adjusted the room weighting for Scoggfirth

Adjusted the position of ammo under the player

Added a frozen palette to the training dummy in the Nexus

Various cutscene polish including speeding up of sequences

Added SFX to Marvin's introduction cutscene

Animated the main menu

Updated the credits


[h1]Bugs[/h1]

And lastly, we addressed the following:
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was preventing players from having independent mod UI layouts while playing in local multiplayer 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug with the Ember Tree where trying to respec while in the “Swap” menu would prevent making any other changes 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing supercharged enemies in Anville from dealing additional damage
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing Praxis buffed enemies from being able to destroy props
[*]Fixed a bug where the buffed enemies from Praxis weren’t getting the reduced freeze duration
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the Praxis gem beam VFX not tracking buffed enemies while frozen 🔥
[*]Fixed some collision issues with Scoggfirth's minibosses
[*]Fixed a bug with freezing Rotworm while burrowing that caused it to become invisible until unfrozen 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing players to destroy Lord Bruma's ice pillars with Blast Bomb
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the Vanguard Champion’s intro
[*]Fixed some visual issues with Mischief’s status effects
[*]Fixed a visual bug with Defense Bot's projectile size
[*]Fixed a bug that was disposing of the mimic pet when spawning a new pet 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing Withercore from extending the duration of poison
[*]Fixed a bug with disconnecting a controller in singleplayer that was preventing players from continuing without plugging the controller back in 🔥
[*]Fixed a visual bug with entering the tear while the inventory or pause screens were open 🔥
[*]Fixed some minor visual issues with the Guardian Bow's arrows
[*]Fixed some minor visual issues with displaying status effect labels
[*]Fixed a camera snapping bug during the Wightsbury intro
[*]Fixed a bug that was displaying a black box on the world intro sequences
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the SFX from playing when a skill is recharged
[*]Fixed various translation issues for all languages[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

As usual, if you want to stay on top of the news, see new content before it's live, share your favourite memes, or simply chat strategy about the best weapons and skills, join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions during the Early Access and beyond, so be sure to join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=discord.gg%2Femberknights&snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!


[i]Stay tuned for more news and updates![/i]

notes.title: Ember Knights 1.0 to release on July 18!
notes.content:
Hello Knights! 

You've already read the title, so there's no need to contain our excitement any longer! We are thrilled to announce that Ember Knights is set to release on [b]July 18th[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=5_w_xj4zGk4;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access is therefore coming to an end next month, and our first thought is to [b]thank all of you[/b]. To everyone who ever played, wrote a review, dropped us a line on Discord or gave us a like on Twitter, thank you! Your valuable feedback and unwavering support have been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. We achieved 2000 reviews on Steam, and an [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] rating too! We're now really looking forward to the next phase. So brace yourselves because 1.0 comes with the final area, new monsters, another weapon, boss variants, the final boss (you know who it is!) and of course, more end game content. 

If you're a newcomer, welcome! Are you ready to be transported to a vibrant, immersive yet deadly pixel-art world? Prepare to wander through enchanted forests, frozen lands, haunted villages, and more! Each session will present you with unique build opportunities and elements to unlock, from fun weapons to game-changing relics and additional Knight colors... And more!

To make your journey even more exciting, you can count on the online multiplayer mode, allowing you to team up with friends. So use the power of friendship and see how far you can get! 

Mark your calendars for July 18th! See you there! 

[h1]Join our vibrant community![/h1]

Stay tuned for more updates and exclusive content by following us on our official channels. We can't wait to share this unforgettable journey with you! 

You can find us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url].
And finally, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/emberknights]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!


[i]See you soon, Knights![/i]

notes.title: Reconnects Update - The Final Stretch
notes.content:
Hello Knights!

This is it - our last scheduled update before 1.0 drops!

While we're hard at work getting the remaining content in for 1.0, we've included the following for 0.12: multiplayer reconnect support, the ability to swap items via an overhauled Offering Pit, balancing to some weapon mods, more boss rewards, a new secret/achievement, and various quality of life improvements to the Ember Tree, Compendium, and shops.


[h1]Offering Pit Rework - Swapping Items[/h1]

The Offering Pit gets a functionality change in this update. Previously players would offer gold to get a reward. Now, you can offer up to 4 items from your inventory to Bob and he will spit out 4 new items of equal type. Got a relic or two that doesn't fit your build? Give them to Bob to try for something new!

The Offering Pit wasn't really working how we wanted it to. Instead of being an interesting choice where you choose how much gold you want to wager against a reward, it ended up bing more like an inferior shop. This update should make the Offering Pit a more desirable room encounter. Swapping items is a feature that we've had requested a few times and we listened!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/450475ab89310a10cd4afb8b2db8c649eedb56c6.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer Reconnects[/h1]

This has been a massive undertaking for us but it's a feature we wanted to bring to you before the final release. There are so many scenarios to test this feature thoroughly so you may encounter some issues along the way. If you do experience any problems, we would greatly appreciate letting us know so we can address them!

[h1]Weapon Mod - Leap[/h1]

After taking some time to look at the Leap mod for the Rift Hammer, we came to the conclusion that it was too spammable while still maintaining I-frames. We wanted to address this but also didn't want to take away the ability to use it multiple times in a row nor reduce the I-frames given. Our solution was to introduce the concept of "Leap charges".

Leap can only be activated when you have a Leap charge available. You gain Leap charges by hitting enemies with the 3rd Attack in the normal attack chain. Up to 3 Leap charges can be stored. These are displayed beneath your Knight. 

It's our hope that this change will encourage a more fluid transition between normal attacks and Leap attacks and promote a healthier playstyle that is more enjoyable for everyone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/5f4355b92a35e242b79877259bc874a980ff4490.gif[/img]


Please see below for the complete list of patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Complete Patch Notes[/h1]
[i]Note: items marked with 🔥 are a result of player feedback[/i]

[h2]New content and features[/h2] 
[h3]Offering Pit - Swapping Items[/h3]
An overhauled Offering Pit now allows players to swap up to 4 items! 🔥

[h3]Multiplayer Reconnects[/h3]
Disconnected players will now be able to rejoin their multiplayer game! 🔥

[h3]Weapon Mods[/h3]
[list][*]Leap - Introduced the concept of Leap charges. Collect charges by using the 3rd attack and spend charges to perform the Leap. Also reduced the minimum distance but increased the damage
[*]Connoisseur - Changed to give one skill selector each time the player beats a miniboss[/list]
[h3]Ember Tree Updates[/h3]
[list][*]Separated the Skill Selector reroll and Relic Selector reroll so players can have both 🔥
[*]Removed the bonus damage to elites and champs, and replaced the bonus damage to normal enemies with bonus damage to non-boss enemies to also include elites and champs
[*]Removed the Stat Selector reroll
[*]Various UI improvements[/list]
[h3]Shop Changes[/h3]
[list][*]Added a chance for Ash to appear in all shops 🔥
[*]Added more levels to the rerolling 🔥
[*]Added progression to the podiums - additional podiums become available as you progress through different worlds
[*]Adjusted the cap price of all items
[*]Streamlined the Nexus Shop unlock sequence[/list]
[h3]Compendium[/h3]
[list][*]Toggle through variants behind their base version
[*]Various UI improvements[/list]
[h3]Boss Rewards[/h3]
Increased the rewards given for beating a boss!

[h3]New Secret/Achievement[/h3]
With the change to the Offering Pit, we had to replace Core Finances. Keep an eye out for a way to defy the mystifying laws of gravity in the Nexus!

[h3]Localizations[/h3]
More translations and fixes! 🔥


[h1]Balancing[/h1] 

In addition to the new content and features, we’ve also made the following changes:
[list][*]Added an end-game conversion of gold to ember for any remaining gold left at the end of a run🔥
[*]Added the concept of rarities to Relic Orbs. Visuals will now represent the rarity of the relic behind the Orb
[*]Adjusted Mimics - added scaling HP and attack power, and decreased base HP
[*]Gave the Mimic King a voice
[*]Reduced the default volume to 50% 🔥
[*]Replaced the door mat icon for minibosses
[*]Replaced the intro logos for Doom Turtle and Twin Sails with their animated versions[/list]

[h1]Bugs [/h1]

And finally, some bug fixing:
[list][*]Fixed a bug that was causing Evee's Care Package reward to occasionally spawn out of reach 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was resetting the difficulty modifiers between runs 🔥
[*]Fixed some visual issues with Anville's miniboss attacks
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the Cleaver's supercharge attack animation 🔥
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the prompt to advance NPC dialogue to disappear
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096630/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

As usual, if you want to stay on top of the news, see new content before it's live, share your favourite memes, or simply chat strategy about the best weapons and skills, join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/emberknightsgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/emberknightsgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheEmberKnights]Twitter[/url]!

We will also be especially grateful for your feedback and suggestions during the Early Access and beyond, so be sure to join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=discord.gg%2Femberknights&snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]Discord[/url] to share your comments directly with our development team!


[i]Stay tuned for more news and updates![/i]
